[Trig]
https://www.w3schools.com/code/tryit.asp?filename=GJTHETE7QPCF

  /|
h/ | o
/__|
  a
o = weight
h = slope
a = CG

const rad = Math.atan(o/a)
First use trig to calculate the "rad" (angle.. in radians)

h = o / Math.sin(rad)
Use trig again to calculate the hypotenuse for any given "o" (opposite length... the weight in this case)

Once I have the opposite and hypotenuse, I can use the Pythagorean Theorem to calculate the "a" length (the CG limit in this case)

a = Math.sqrt(h*h - o*o) // Adjacent

getForwardLimit(weight){
  ** o1 and a1 come from the plane's limit chart **
  const rad = Math.atan(o1/a1)
  const h = weight / Math.sin(rad)
  const limit = Math.sqrt(h*h - weight*weight)
  return limit
}

#!/bin/sh
#
# An example hook script to check the commit log message taken by
# applypatch from an e-mail message.
#
# The hook should exit with non-zero status after issuing an
# appropriate message if it wants to stop the commit.  The hook is
# allowed to edit the commit message file.
#
# To enable this hook, rename this file to "applypatch-msg".

. git-sh-setup
commitmsg="$(git rev-parse --git-path hooks/commit-msg)"
test -x "$commitmsg" && exec "$commitmsg" ${1+"$@"}
:
#!/bin/sh
#
# An example hook script to check the commit log message.
# Called by "git commit" with one argument, the name of the file
# that has the commit message.  The hook should exit with non-zero
# status after issuing an appropriate message if it wants to stop the
# commit.  The hook is allowed to edit the commit message file.
#
# To enable this hook, rename this file to "commit-msg".

# Uncomment the below to add a Signed-off-by line to the message.
# Doing this in a hook is a bad idea in general, but the prepare-commit-msg
# hook is more suited to it.
#
# SOB=$(git var GIT_AUTHOR_IDENT | sed -n 's/^\(.*>\).*$/Signed-off-by: \1/p')
# grep -qs "^$SOB" "$1" || echo "$SOB" >> "$1"

# This example catches duplicate Signed-off-by lines.

test "" = "$(grep '^Signed-off-by: ' "$1" |
	 sort | uniq -c | sed -e '/^[ 	]*1[ 	]/d')" || {
	echo >&2 Duplicate Signed-off-by lines.
	exit 1
}
#!/usr/bin/perl

use strict;
use warnings;
use IPC::Open2;

# An example hook script to integrate Watchman
# (https://facebook.github.io/watchman/) with git to speed up detecting
# new and modified files.
#
# The hook is passed a version (currently 1) and a time in nanoseconds
# formatted as a string and outputs to stdout all files that have been
# modified since the given time. Paths must be relative to the root of
# the working tree and separated by a single NUL.
#
# To enable this hook, rename this file to "query-watchman" and set
# 'git config core.fsmonitor .git/hooks/query-watchman'
#
my ($version, $time) = @ARGV;

# Check the hook interface version

if ($version == 1) {
	# convert nanoseconds to seconds
	$time = int $time / 1000000000;
} else {
	die "Unsupported query-fsmonitor hook version '$version'.\n" .
	    "Falling back to scanning...\n";
}

my $git_work_tree;
if ($^O =~ 'msys' || $^O =~ 'cygwin') {
	$git_work_tree = Win32::GetCwd();
	$git_work_tree =~ tr/\\/\//;
} else {
	require Cwd;
	$git_work_tree = Cwd::cwd();
}

my $retry = 1;

launch_watchman();

sub launch_watchman {

	my $pid = open2(\*CHLD_OUT, \*CHLD_IN, 'watchman -j --no-pretty')
	    or die "open2() failed: $!\n" .
	    "Falling back to scanning...\n";

	# In the query expression below we're asking for names of files that
	# changed since $time but were not transient (ie created after
	# $time but no longer exist).
	#
	# To accomplish this, we're using the "since" generator to use the
	# recency index to select candidate nodes and "fields" to limit the
	# output to file names only. Then we're using the "expression" term to
	# further constrain the results.
	#
	# The category of transient files that we want to ignore will have a
	# creation clock (cclock) newer than $time_t value and will also not
	# currently exist.

	my $query = <<"	END";
		["query", "$git_work_tree", {
			"since": $time,
			"fields": ["name"],
			"expression": ["not", ["allof", ["since", $time, "cclock"], ["not", "exists"]]]
		}]
	END

	print CHLD_IN $query;
	close CHLD_IN;
	my $response = do {local $/; <CHLD_OUT>};

	die "Watchman: command returned no output.\n" .
	    "Falling back to scanning...\n" if $response eq "";
	die "Watchman: command returned invalid output: $response\n" .
	    "Falling back to scanning...\n" unless $response =~ /^\{/;

	my $json_pkg;
	eval {
		require JSON::XS;
		$json_pkg = "JSON::XS";
		1;
	} or do {
		require JSON::PP;
		$json_pkg = "JSON::PP";
	};

	my $o = $json_pkg->new->utf8->decode($response);

	if ($retry > 0 and $o->{error} and $o->{error} =~ m/unable to resolve root .* directory (.*) is not watched/) {
		print STDERR "Adding '$git_work_tree' to watchman's watch list.\n";
		$retry--;
		qx/watchman watch "$git_work_tree"/;
		die "Failed to make watchman watch '$git_work_tree'.\n" .
		    "Falling back to scanning...\n" if $? != 0;

		# Watchman will always return all files on the first query so
		# return the fast "everything is dirty" flag to git and do the
		# Watchman query just to get it over with now so we won't pay
		# the cost in git to look up each individual file.
		print "/\0";
		eval { launch_watchman() };
		exit 0;
	}

	die "Watchman: $o->{error}.\n" .
	    "Falling back to scanning...\n" if $o->{error};

	binmode STDOUT, ":utf8";
	local $, = "\0";
	print @{$o->{files}};
}

#!/bin/sh
#
# An example hook script to verify what is about to be committed
# by applypatch from an e-mail message.
#
# The hook should exit with non-zero status after issuing an
# appropriate message if it wants to stop the commit.
#
# To enable this hook, rename this file to "pre-applypatch".

. git-sh-setup
precommit="$(git rev-parse --git-path hooks/pre-commit)"
test -x "$precommit" && exec "$precommit" ${1+"$@"}
:
#!/bin/sh
#
# An example hook script to verify what is about to be committed.
# Called by "git commit" with no arguments.  The hook should
# exit with non-zero status after issuing an appropriate message if
# it wants to stop the commit.
#
# To enable this hook, rename this file to "pre-commit".

if git rev-parse --verify HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1
then
	against=HEAD
else
	# Initial commit: diff against an empty tree object
	against=$(git hash-object -t tree /dev/null)
fi

# If you want to allow non-ASCII filenames set this variable to true.
allownonascii=$(git config --bool hooks.allownonascii)

# Redirect output to stderr.
exec 1>&2

# Cross platform projects tend to avoid non-ASCII filenames; prevent
# them from being added to the repository. We exploit the fact that the
# printable range starts at the space character and ends with tilde.
if [ "$allownonascii" != "true" ] &&
	# Note that the use of brackets around a tr range is ok here, (it's
	# even required, for portability to Solaris 10's /usr/bin/tr), since
	# the square bracket bytes happen to fall in the designated range.
	test $(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=A -z $against |
	  LC_ALL=C tr -d '[ -~]\0' | wc -c) != 0
then
	cat <<\EOF
Error: Attempt to add a non-ASCII file name.

This can cause problems if you want to work with people on other platforms.

To be portable it is advisable to rename the file.

If you know what you are doing you can disable this check using:

  git config hooks.allownonascii true
EOF
	exit 1
fi

# If there are whitespace errors, print the offending file names and fail.
exec git diff-index --check --cached $against --
#!/bin/sh

# An example hook script to verify what is about to be pushed.  Called by "git
# push" after it has checked the remote status, but before anything has been
# pushed.  If this script exits with a non-zero status nothing will be pushed.
#
# This hook is called with the following parameters:
#
# $1 -- Name of the remote to which the push is being done
# $2 -- URL to which the push is being done
#
# If pushing without using a named remote those arguments will be equal.
#
# Information about the commits which are being pushed is supplied as lines to
# the standard input in the form:
#
#   <local ref> <local sha1> <remote ref> <remote sha1>
#
# This sample shows how to prevent push of commits where the log message starts
# with "WIP" (work in progress).

remote="$1"
url="$2"

z40=0000000000000000000000000000000000000000

while read local_ref local_sha remote_ref remote_sha
do
	if [ "$local_sha" = $z40 ]
	then
		# Handle delete
		:
	else
		if [ "$remote_sha" = $z40 ]
		then
			# New branch, examine all commits
			range="$local_sha"
		else
			# Update to existing branch, examine new commits
			range="$remote_sha..$local_sha"
		fi

		# Check for WIP commit
		commit=`git rev-list -n 1 --grep '^WIP' "$range"`
		if [ -n "$commit" ]
		then
			echo >&2 "Found WIP commit in $local_ref, not pushing"
			exit 1
		fi
	fi
done

exit 0
#!/bin/sh
#
# Copyright (c) 2006, 2008 Junio C Hamano
#
# The "pre-rebase" hook is run just before "git rebase" starts doing
# its job, and can prevent the command from running by exiting with
# non-zero status.
#
# The hook is called with the following parameters:
#
# $1 -- the upstream the series was forked from.
# $2 -- the branch being rebased (or empty when rebasing the current branch).
#
# This sample shows how to prevent topic branches that are already
# merged to 'next' branch from getting rebased, because allowing it
# would result in rebasing already published history.

publish=next
basebranch="$1"
if test "$#" = 2
then
	topic="refs/heads/$2"
else
	topic=`git symbolic-ref HEAD` ||
	exit 0 ;# we do not interrupt rebasing detached HEAD
fi

case "$topic" in
refs/heads/??/*)
	;;
*)
	exit 0 ;# we do not interrupt others.
	;;
esac

# Now we are dealing with a topic branch being rebased
# on top of master.  Is it OK to rebase it?

# Does the topic really exist?
git show-ref -q "$topic" || {
	echo >&2 "No such branch $topic"
	exit 1
}

# Is topic fully merged to master?
not_in_master=`git rev-list --pretty=oneline ^master "$topic"`
if test -z "$not_in_master"
then
	echo >&2 "$topic is fully merged to master; better remove it."
	exit 1 ;# we could allow it, but there is no point.
fi

# Is topic ever merged to next?  If so you should not be rebasing it.
only_next_1=`git rev-list ^master "^$topic" ${publish} | sort`
only_next_2=`git rev-list ^master           ${publish} | sort`
if test "$only_next_1" = "$only_next_2"
then
	not_in_topic=`git rev-list "^$topic" master`
	if test -z "$not_in_topic"
	then
		echo >&2 "$topic is already up to date with master"
		exit 1 ;# we could allow it, but there is no point.
	else
		exit 0
	fi
else
	not_in_next=`git rev-list --pretty=oneline ^${publish} "$topic"`
	/usr/bin/perl -e '
		my $topic = $ARGV[0];
		my $msg = "* $topic has commits already merged to public branch:\n";
		my (%not_in_next) = map {
			/^([0-9a-f]+) /;
			($1 => 1);
		} split(/\n/, $ARGV[1]);
		for my $elem (map {
				/^([0-9a-f]+) (.*)$/;
				[$1 => $2];
			} split(/\n/, $ARGV[2])) {
			if (!exists $not_in_next{$elem->[0]}) {
				if ($msg) {
					print STDERR $msg;
					undef $msg;
				}
				print STDERR " $elem->[1]\n";
			}
		}
	' "$topic" "$not_in_next" "$not_in_master"
	exit 1
fi

<<\DOC_END

This sample hook safeguards topic branches that have been
published from being rewound.

The workflow assumed here is:

 * Once a topic branch forks from "master", "master" is never
   merged into it again (either directly or indirectly).

 * Once a topic branch is fully cooked and merged into "master",
   it is deleted.  If you need to build on top of it to correct
   earlier mistakes, a new topic branch is created by forking at
   the tip of the "master".  This is not strictly necessary, but
   it makes it easier to keep your history simple.

 * Whenever you need to test or publish your changes to topic
   branches, merge them into "next" branch.

The script, being an example, hardcodes the publish branch name
to be "next", but it is trivial to make it configurable via
$GIT_DIR/config mechanism.

With this workflow, you would want to know:

(1) ... if a topic branch has ever been merged to "next".  Young
    topic branches can have stupid mistakes you would rather
    clean up before publishing, and things that have not been
    merged into other branches can be easily rebased without
    affecting other people.  But once it is published, you would
    not want to rewind it.

(2) ... if a topic branch has been fully merged to "master".
    Then you can delete it.  More importantly, you should not
    build on top of it -- other people may already want to
    change things related to the topic as patches against your
    "master", so if you need further changes, it is better to
    fork the topic (perhaps with the same name) afresh from the
    tip of "master".

Let's look at this example:

		   o---o---o---o---o---o---o---o---o---o "next"
		  /       /           /           /
		 /   a---a---b A     /           /
		/   /               /           /
	       /   /   c---c---c---c B         /
	      /   /   /             \         /
	     /   /   /   b---b C     \       /
	    /   /   /   /             \     /
    ---o---o---o---o---o---o---o---o---o---o---o "master"


A, B and C are topic branches.

 * A has one fix since it was merged up to "next".

 * B has finished.  It has been fully merged up to "master" and "next",
   and is ready to be deleted.

 * C has not merged to "next" at all.

We would want to allow C to be rebased, refuse A, and encourage
B to be deleted.

To compute (1):

	git rev-list ^master ^topic next
	git rev-list ^master        next

	if these match, topic has not merged in next at all.

To compute (2):

	git rev-list master..topic

	if this is empty, it is fully merged to "master".

DOC_END
#!/bin/sh
#
# An example hook script to make use of push options.
# The example simply echoes all push options that start with 'echoback='
# and rejects all pushes when the "reject" push option is used.
#
# To enable this hook, rename this file to "pre-receive".

if test -n "$GIT_PUSH_OPTION_COUNT"
then
	i=0
	while test "$i" -lt "$GIT_PUSH_OPTION_COUNT"
	do
		eval "value=\$GIT_PUSH_OPTION_$i"
		case "$value" in
		echoback=*)
			echo "echo from the pre-receive-hook: ${value#*=}" >&2
			;;
		reject)
			exit 1
		esac
		i=$((i + 1))
	done
fi
#!/bin/sh
#
# An example hook script to prepare the commit log message.
# Called by "git commit" with the name of the file that has the
# commit message, followed by the description of the commit
# message's source.  The hook's purpose is to edit the commit
# message file.  If the hook fails with a non-zero status,
# the commit is aborted.
#
# To enable this hook, rename this file to "prepare-commit-msg".

# This hook includes three examples. The first one removes the
# "# Please enter the commit message..." help message.
#
# The second includes the output of "git diff --name-status -r"
# into the message, just before the "git status" output.  It is
# commented because it doesn't cope with --amend or with squashed
# commits.
#
# The third example adds a Signed-off-by line to the message, that can
# still be edited.  This is rarely a good idea.

COMMIT_MSG_FILE=$1
COMMIT_SOURCE=$2
SHA1=$3

/usr/bin/perl -i.bak -ne 'print unless(m/^. Please enter the commit message/..m/^#$/)' "$COMMIT_MSG_FILE"

# case "$COMMIT_SOURCE,$SHA1" in
#  ,|template,)
#    /usr/bin/perl -i.bak -pe '
#       print "\n" . `git diff --cached --name-status -r`
# 	 if /^#/ && $first++ == 0' "$COMMIT_MSG_FILE" ;;
#  *) ;;
# esac

# SOB=$(git var GIT_COMMITTER_IDENT | sed -n 's/^\(.*>\).*$/Signed-off-by: \1/p')
# git interpret-trailers --in-place --trailer "$SOB" "$COMMIT_MSG_FILE"
# if test -z "$COMMIT_SOURCE"
# then
#   /usr/bin/perl -i.bak -pe 'print "\n" if !$first_line++' "$COMMIT_MSG_FILE"
# fi
#!/bin/sh
#
# An example hook script to block unannotated tags from entering.
# Called by "git receive-pack" with arguments: refname sha1-old sha1-new
#
# To enable this hook, rename this file to "update".
#
# Config
# ------
# hooks.allowunannotated
#   This boolean sets whether unannotated tags will be allowed into the
#   repository.  By default they won't be.
# hooks.allowdeletetag
#   This boolean sets whether deleting tags will be allowed in the
#   repository.  By default they won't be.
# hooks.allowmodifytag
#   This boolean sets whether a tag may be modified after creation. By default
#   it won't be.
# hooks.allowdeletebranch
#   This boolean sets whether deleting branches will be allowed in the
#   repository.  By default they won't be.
# hooks.denycreatebranch
#   This boolean sets whether remotely creating branches will be denied
#   in the repository.  By default this is allowed.
#

# --- Command line
refname="$1"
oldrev="$2"
newrev="$3"

# --- Safety check
if [ -z "$GIT_DIR" ]; then
	echo "Don't run this script from the command line." >&2
	echo " (if you want, you could supply GIT_DIR then run" >&2
	echo "  $0 <ref> <oldrev> <newrev>)" >&2
	exit 1
fi

if [ -z "$refname" -o -z "$oldrev" -o -z "$newrev" ]; then
	echo "usage: $0 <ref> <oldrev> <newrev>" >&2
	exit 1
fi

# --- Config
allowunannotated=$(git config --bool hooks.allowunannotated)
allowdeletebranch=$(git config --bool hooks.allowdeletebranch)
denycreatebranch=$(git config --bool hooks.denycreatebranch)
allowdeletetag=$(git config --bool hooks.allowdeletetag)
allowmodifytag=$(git config --bool hooks.allowmodifytag)

# check for no description
projectdesc=$(sed -e '1q' "$GIT_DIR/description")
case "$projectdesc" in
"Unnamed repository"* | "")
	echo "*** Project description file hasn't been set" >&2
	exit 1
	;;
esac

# --- Check types
# if $newrev is 0000...0000, it's a commit to delete a ref.
zero="0000000000000000000000000000000000000000"
if [ "$newrev" = "$zero" ]; then
	newrev_type=delete
else
	newrev_type=$(git cat-file -t $newrev)
fi

case "$refname","$newrev_type" in
	refs/tags/*,commit)
		# un-annotated tag
		short_refname=${refname##refs/tags/}
		if [ "$allowunannotated" != "true" ]; then
			echo "*** The un-annotated tag, $short_refname, is not allowed in this repository" >&2
			echo "*** Use 'git tag [ -a | -s ]' for tags you want to propagate." >&2
			exit 1
		fi
		;;
	refs/tags/*,delete)
		# delete tag
		if [ "$allowdeletetag" != "true" ]; then
			echo "*** Deleting a tag is not allowed in this repository" >&2
			exit 1
		fi
		;;
	refs/tags/*,tag)
		# annotated tag
		if [ "$allowmodifytag" != "true" ] && git rev-parse $refname > /dev/null 2>&1
		then
			echo "*** Tag '$refname' already exists." >&2
			echo "*** Modifying a tag is not allowed in this repository." >&2
			exit 1
		fi
		;;
	refs/heads/*,commit)
		# branch
		if [ "$oldrev" = "$zero" -a "$denycreatebranch" = "true" ]; then
			echo "*** Creating a branch is not allowed in this repository" >&2
			exit 1
		fi
		;;
	refs/heads/*,delete)
		# delete branch
		if [ "$allowdeletebranch" != "true" ]; then
			echo "*** Deleting a branch is not allowed in this repository" >&2
			exit 1
		fi
		;;
	refs/remotes/*,commit)
		# tracking branch
		;;
	refs/remotes/*,delete)
		# delete tracking branch
		if [ "$allowdeletebranch" != "true" ]; then
			echo "*** Deleting a tracking branch is not allowed in this repository" >&2
			exit 1
		fi
		;;
	*)
		# Anything else (is there anything else?)
		echo "*** Update hook: unknown type of update to ref $refname of type $newrev_type" >&2
		exit 1
		;;
esac

# --- Finished
exit 0

<script>
  //
  // Weight in KG
  // Arm in Meter
  //
  class Station {
    constructor(data) {
      this.type = data.type || ""
      this.weight = data.weight || 0
      this.arm = data.arm || 0
      this.moment = this.weight * this.arm
    }
  }

  class Airplane {
    constructor(data) {
      // data.REG data.Weight,data.ARM,data.Moment,data.Type,data.RegColor] *** update with new signature ***
      this.reg = data.reg
      this.regcolor = data.regcolor
      this.weight = data.weight
      this.arm = data.arm
      this.moment = data.moment
      this.burn = {
        // climb:
        // cruise:
        // descent:
      }
      this.limit = {
        // cg: [forard,aft]
        // weight: [TO,LND,Ramp]
        // fuel: (capacity)
      }
      this.stations = [
        // {
        // accepts: ["crew","pax","cargo","seat","fuel","other"(controls/pods)] // perhaps more "others" details? *************
        // type: (any of the accepts)
        // weight:
        // arm:
        // limit:
        // }
      ]
      this.load = [
        // {
        //   id: // this.getNextLoadId() ... simple counter.
        //   station:
        //   type:
        //   weight:
        // },
        // {},
        // {}
      ]
    }
    getSeats() {
      // ******************
      // analyse stations to see how many seats are installed.
      // default loading of airplane will contain the seats at station
      // will also contain the controls
      // and anything else that we have the data for.
      // we can remove items with negative loads if necessary.
      const result = this.stations((item) => item.type == "seat")
      return result
    }

    // ************************************************************************************************
    addLoad(load) {
      // Accepts: {id,station,type,weight} {station}

      // ************ Need checks **************************
      // if id exists, make sure it hasn't been used already
      // if it has, just get a new one .... this.getNextLoadId()
      // if no id exists, get one.
      let legal = false
      if (this.isLegal(load)) {
        load.id = this.getNextLoadId()
        this.load.push(load)
        legal = true
      }
      return ret
    }
    isLegal(load) {
      // check type and limits, return T/F
    }
    removeLoad(load) {
      // remove obj by load.id
    }
    getWB() {
      // calculate CG based on load (simple WAM)
      // return [w/cg]
      //
      // Calculate all moments
      //
      this.stations.forEach((station) => {
        station.moment = station.weight * station.arm
      })
      //
      // Since our airplane data moments inexplicably don't equal weight*arm, we need a seperate Station object for them.
      //
      let loadsheet = new Station({
        type: ["airplane"],
        weight: this.weight,
        arm: this.arm,
      })
      loadsheet.moment = this.moment
      this.stations.push(loadsheet)
      //
      // Sum all Weights and Moments
      //
      const totalWeight = this.stations.reduce((total, station) => total + parseFloat(station.weight), 0)
      const totalMoment = this.stations.reduce((total, station) => total + parseFloat(station.moment), 0)
      const CG = totalMoment / totalWeight
      const rCG = Math.round((CG + Number.EPSILON) * 1000) / 1000
      const rAUW = Math.round((totalWeight + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100
      //const roundCG = Math.round((CG + Number.EPSILON) * 1000) / 1000
      const wb = {
        AUW: totalWeight,
        cg: CG,
        rounded: {
          AUW: rAUW,
          cg: rCG,
        },
      }
      return wb
    }
    getNextLoadId() {
      // return highest ID in current load + 1
      let count = 0
      this.load.forEach((element) => {
        if (element.id >= count) {
          count = element.id + 1
        }
      })
      return count
    }
    // ************************************************************************************************
  }

    writeBoard() {
      console.log("Write Board")
      // ----------------------
      // The Board Table
      // ----------------------
      this.$board.append(
        '<div style="float:left; display: inline-block;"><table class="BoardTable" id="MYTable"/></div>'
      )

      // ----------------------
      // Root
      // ----------------------

      for (let i = 1; i <= this.numCols; i++) {
        let planeCell = new PlaneCell(this, 0, i)
        $row.append(planeCell.$this)
      }
      $table.append($row)
      //
      // Plotting Board
      //
      for (let r = 1; r <= this.numRows; r++) {
        // After the header row, we'll loop over the row maker function
        let thisRow = r
        let thisHour = time.getHourByRow(thisRow, 2)
        let myRow = []

        // Pickup Column
        //
        myRow.push($('<td class="PickupCell" id="Row_' + thisRow + '"><span style="color: white;">00</span></td>'))
        //
        // Time column
        //

        $timeTD.addClass("TimeCell Row_" + thisRow + " Col_0")
        $timeTD.attr("id", thisRow + "_0")
        $timeTD.data("hour", thisHour)
        $timeTD.data("row", thisRow)

        let $HS = $("<span />")
          .text(thisHour + ":00")
          .addClass("HourSchedule")

        let $hHS = $("<span />")
          .text(thisHour + ":30")
          .addClass("HalfHourSchedule")
        //.hide()

        $timeTD.append($HS)

        myRow.push($timeTD)
        //

        //
        for (let c = 1; c <= this.numCols; c++) {
          let TC = new TableCell(this, r, c)
          TC.$board = this.$board
          TC.hour = thisHour
          let $TC = TC.$this // The class contructor makes a jQuery object and stores it in $this
          myRow.push($TC)
        }
        this.newRow($table, myRow)

      // DatePicker

      this.$board

      $(".HourSchedule").hide()

      let _this = this

<script>
  /*
The bookings object holds all the bookings loaded in from rezdy (or other booking service)
We keep them in a master array, bookings, and have accessors to manipulate them in place.

This object can handle all of the error checking (like null checking)
*/
  var Bookings = {
    list: [],
    add: function (list) {
      this.list = $.merge(list, this.list)
    },
    getManifest: function (date) {
      console.log("Bookings.getManifest(%o)",date)
      let manifest = {}
      if (!!date && date.match(/\d\d.\d\d.*/gi)) {
        // Checkvalve... date is sane
      } else {
        console.log("Booking.getManifest() error... bad date: %o", date)
        // ***************************************************************
        // if no date, maybe assume the date from the "today" date picker?
        // for now, we'll just return
        return
      }
      for (let a in this.list) {
        if (!!this.list[a] && this.list[a].flight) {
          if (this.list[a].flight.date == date) {
            manifest[this.list[a].orderNumber] = this.list[a]
          }
        }
      }
      return manifest
    },
    get: function (orderNumber) {
      if (!!orderNumber) {
        for (let a in this.list) {
          if (this.list[a].orderNumber == orderNumber) {
            return this.list[a]
          }
        }
      }
      return null
    },
    getBookings: function (date) {
      let b = []
      //
      // If a date was passed in
      //
      if (!!date && date.match(/\d\d.\d\d.*/gi)) {
        for (let a in this.list) {
          if (this.list[a].orderNumber == orderNumber) {
            return this.list[a]
          }
        }
      }
      return b
    },
  }

function saveState(state) {
  var DataID = "1izT_h7z9z2vHYs7TcRQq4EFWYXYwlm-C9Tcn_Ce-V-c" // Data Spreadsheet ID
  var sheet = SpreadsheetApp.openById(DataID).getSheetByName("state") // worksheet name
  var range = sheet.getRange("A:B")
  var data = range.getValues()
  var numRows = range.getNumRows()
  var numCols = range.getNumColumns()
}
function getState(find) {
  var DataID = "1izT_h7z9z2vHYs7TcRQq4EFWYXYwlm-C9Tcn_Ce-V-c" // Data Spreadsheet ID
  var sheet = SpreadsheetApp.openById(DataID).getSheetByName("state") // worksheet name
  var range = sheet.getRange("A:B")
  var values = range.getValues()
  var outputArr = values
    .map(function (rowData, rowIndex) {
      var colIndex = rowData.indexOf(find)
      if (colIndex > -1) {
        return sheet.getRange(rowIndex + 1, colIndex + 1).getA1Notation() // A1Notation means cell reference; like A1, BC23 etc.
      }
    })
    .filter(function (cellData) {
      // eliminating all null elements from the array returned using `map`
      return cellData != null
    })
  return outputArr
}
function saveBoard(_array) {
  var date = _array[0]

  var d = new Date()
  var time = d.getTime()

  var DataID = "1izT_h7z9z2vHYs7TcRQq4EFWYXYwlm-C9Tcn_Ce-V-c" // Data Spreadsheet ID
  var sheet = SpreadsheetApp.openById(DataID).getSheetByName("TheBoardData")
  var metaSheet = SpreadsheetApp.openById(DataID).getSheetByName("TheBoardMeta") // second sheet for meta data like the last save time
  var range = sheet.getRange("A:E") // Number of columns needs to match getRange below... last number is the number of rows. // needs to match (below) *********************!!!!!!!!!!
  var data = range.getValues()
  var numRows = range.getNumRows()
  var numCols = range.getNumColumns()

  var values = [_array]

  for (var i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
    if (data[i][0] == date) {
      sheet.getRange(i + 1, 1, 1, numCols).clearContent()
      delete data[i]
    }
  }

  var lastRow = sheet.getLastRow()
  var lastColumn = sheet.getLastColumn()
  var cell = sheet.getRange(lastRow + 1, 1, 1, 5)

  cell.setValues(values)
  metaSheet.getRange("A1").setValue(time)
  return time
}
function getNZdate(d) {
  d = new Date(d)
  var dd = String(d.getDate())
  if (dd.length < 2) {
    dd = "0" + dd
  }
  var mm = String(d.getMonth() + 1)
  if (mm.length < 2) {
    mm = "0" + mm
  }
  var yyyy = d.getFullYear()

  d = dd + "/" + mm + "/" + yyyy
  return d
}

function saveLoadsheet(data) {
  // date,time,pilot,plane,fuel,route,pax,paxWeights,pilotWeight,TOW,CG,numPax

  var DataID = "1izT_h7z9z2vHYs7TcRQq4EFWYXYwlm-C9Tcn_Ce-V-c" // Data Spreadsheet ID
  var sheet = SpreadsheetApp.openById(DataID).getSheetByName("Flight Data")

  // ================
  // Remove old rows
  // ================
  var date = data.date
  var time = data.time
  var pilot = data.pilot
  var plane = data.reg

  Logger.log("Date:" + date.toString())
  //
  // "Sanity" ->  Date / Time / Pilot / Plane (A:D)
  //
  var sanity = sheet.getRange("A:E").getValues() // also needs to match saveBoard() above *********************!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
  for (var a in sanity) {
    // Date
    var d = getNZdate(sanity[a][0])
    if (date.toString() == d) {
      Logger.log("Match: " + d)

      // Same Plane
      // different load (EX: last minute pax, crew hops in, etc)
      if (sanity[a][1] == time && sanity[a][3] == plane) {
        // Same time and plane, delete the row (and replace with new row)
        sheet.deleteRow(parseInt(a) + 1)
      } else {
        // Same Pilot, different plane (EX: Pilot Swaps Plane)
        if (sanity[a][1] == time && sanity[a][2] == pilot) {
          // Same time and pilot, delete the row (and replace with new row)
          sheet.deleteRow(parseInt(a) + 1)
        }
      }
    }
  }
  var _row = [
    data.date,
    data.time,
    data.pilot,
    data.reg,
    data.fuel,
    data.routes,
    data.paxNames,
    data.paxWeights,
    data.crewWeight,
    data.TOW,
    data.CG,
    data.numPax,
    data.copilot,
  ]
  sheet.appendRow(_row)
  sheet.getRange(sheet.getLastRow(), 2).setNumberFormat("@") // make the time column a number so google doesn't try to interpret the time
  return date + " Saved"
}

function loadBoard(date) {
  // Testing:
  //date = "28/12/2019"

  var DataID = "1izT_h7z9z2vHYs7TcRQq4EFWYXYwlm-C9Tcn_Ce-V-c" // Data Spreadsheet ID
  var range = SpreadsheetApp.openById(DataID).getSheetByName("TheBoardData").getRange("A:E") // needs to match saveBoard (above) *********************!!!!!!!!!!
  var data = range.getValues()

  var numRows = range.getNumRows()
  var numCols = range.getNumColumns()

  var ret = null
  for (var i = 0; i < numRows; i++) {
    if (data[i][0] == date && data[i][1]) {
      ret = [data[i][1], data[i][2], data[i][3], data[i][4]] // needs to match saveBoard (above) *********************!!!!!!!!!!
    }
  }
  return ret
}

function loadRoster(date) {
  //https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1zkA22oiIPbnggme0cosvPnnTkRPCSkkCcc-2mFSclLg/edit#gid=211032400
  const DataID = "1zkA22oiIPbnggme0cosvPnnTkRPCSkkCcc-2mFSclLg" // Company Data Spreadsheet ID
  const workbook = SpreadsheetApp.openById(DataID)
  const sheets = workbook.getSheets()
  const tabs = sheets.map((x) => {
    return x.getName()
  })
  date = new Date(date)
  let match = {}
  const week = tabs.map((s) => {
    const sheet = workbook.getSheetByName(s)
    const rangeValues = sheet.getRange("A2:H2").getValues()
    rangeValues.map((r, ri) => {
      r.map((c, ci) => {
        const cd = new Date(c)
        if (cd.toString() == date.toString()) {
          match.ci = ci
          match.sheet = s
          match.match = true
        }
      })
    })
  })

  if (match.match) {
    const _sheet = workbook.getSheetByName(match.sheet)
    const rng = "A4:H17"
    const rangeValues = _sheet.getRange(rng).getValues()
    const rangeColors = _sheet.getRange(rng).getBackgrounds()
    match.values = rangeValues
    match.colors = rangeColors
    return match
  }
}

      let tp = typeof arg
      let num
      typeof arg === "undefined"
        ? (num = 0)
        : typeof arg === "object"
        ? (num = 1)
        : typeof arg === "string"
        ? (num = this.getColorNum(arg))
        : (num = 0)

      if (num >= this.colorList.length) {
        num = 0
      }

      let ret = {}
      ret.in = this.colorList[num][0]
      ret.out = this.colorList[num][1]
      ret.highlight = this.colorList[num][2] // Basic In/Out highlight (Just the in highlight)
      ret.h1 = this.colorList[num][2] // In highlight
      ret.h2 = this.colorList[num][3] // Out highlight
      return ret
    }

          break
        case "4:00":

<script>
  Date.prototype.addDays = function (days) {
    let date = new Date(this.valueOf())
    date.setDate(date.getDate() + days)
    return date
  }

  //-------------------------------------------
  // Quick and dirty version:
  //let d1 = new Date(dateList[i][0]);
  //let d2 = new Date(values[v][0]);
  //let same = d1.getTime() === d2.getTime();
  //let notSame = d1.getTime() !== d2.getTime();
  //--------------------------------------------

  var Dates = {
    initPicker: function ($picker, _board) {
      //
      // DatePicker
      //
      // Set the picker to NZ format (dd/mm/yyyy) and to today's date
      // Then remove focus
      $picker.datepicker({
        dateFormat: "dd/mm/yy",
        firstDay: 1,
        onSelect: function (dateText) {
          _board.load(this)
          $(this).blur()
        },
      })
      $picker.datepicker("setDate", "today")
    },
    //
    // Takes a NZ formatted date String and returns a JS Date Object
    // 24/8/2020
    //
    getFromNZ: function (d) {
      d = d.split("/")
      d = d.map(x => parseInt(x))
      return new Date([d[2],d[1]+1,d[0]])
    },
    getNZ: function (d,short) {
      //if (typeof d === 'undefined') {d = new Date()}
      typeof d === "undefined" ? (d = new Date()) : d.constructor === Date ? d : (d = new Date(d))

      let dd = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")
      let mm = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0") //January is 0!
      let yyyy = d.getFullYear()
      let yy = "" + d.getYear()
      yy = yy.substr(1) 

      d = dd + "/" + mm + "/" + yyyy
      if (!!short){
        d = dd + "/" + mm + "/" + yy
      }
      return d
    },
    getUSA: function (d) {
      //if (typeof d === 'undefined') {d = new Date()}
      typeof d === "undefined" ? (d = new Date()) : d.constructor === Date ? d : (d = new Date(d))

      let dd = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")
      let mm = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0") //January is 0!
      let yyyy = d.getFullYear()

      d = mm + "/" + dd + "/" + yyyy
      return d
    },
    getJustDate: function (d) {
      // Right now, this is just a copy of getNZ() *************************
      // Convert a date object to a String with just dd/mm/yyyy
      typeof d === "undefined" ? (d = new Date()) : d.constructor === Date ? d : (d = new Date(d))
      let dd = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")
      let mm = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0") //January is 0!
      let yyyy = d.getFullYear()
      d = dd + "/" + mm + "/" + yyyy
      return d
    },
    convert: function (d) {
      // Converts the date in d to a date-object. The input can be:
      //   a date object: returned without modification
      //  an array      : Interpreted as [year,month,day]. NOTE: month is 0-11.
      //   a number     : Interpreted as number of milliseconds
      //                  since 1 Jan 1970 (a timestamp)
      //   a string     : Any format supported by the javascript engine, like
      //                  "YYYY/MM/DD", "MM/DD/YYYY", "Jan 31 2009" etc.
      //  an object     : Interpreted as an object with year, month and date
      //                  attributes.  **NOTE** month is 0-11.
      return d.constructor === Date
        ? d
        : d.constructor === Array
        ? new Date(d[0], d[1], d[2])
        : d.constructor === Number
        ? new Date(d)
        : d.constructor === String
        ? new Date(d)
        : typeof d === "object"
        ? new Date(d.year, d.month, d.date)
        : NaN
    },
    compare: function (a, b) {
      // Compare two dates (could be of any type supported by the convert
      // function above) and returns:
      //  -1 : if a < b
      //   0 : if a = b
      //   1 : if a > b
      // NaN : if a or b is an illegal date
      // NOTE: The code inside isFinite does an assignment (=).
      return isFinite((a = this.convert(a).valueOf())) && isFinite((b = this.convert(b).valueOf()))
        ? (a > b) - (a < b)
        : NaN
    },
    inRange: function (d, start, end) {
      // Checks if date in d is between dates in start and end.
      // Returns a boolean or NaN:
      //    true  : if d is between start and end (inclusive)
      //    false : if d is before start or after end
      //    NaN   : if one or more of the dates is illegal.
      // NOTE: The code inside isFinite does an assignment (=).
      return isFinite((d = this.convert(d).valueOf())) &&
        isFinite((start = this.convert(start).valueOf())) &&
        isFinite((end = this.convert(end).valueOf()))
        ? start <= d && d <= end
        : NaN
    },
  }
</script>

        // }
        //
        // If there's nothing left, clear the cell. Otherwise set the JSON equal to whatever bookings are left.
        //
        if (bookings.length < 1) {
          this.clearCell(cell)
        } else {
          cell.data("json", _bookings)
        }
      }
    },
    clearCell: function (cell) {
      cell.removeData("json")
      cell.removeData("type")
      cell.css("background", "")
      cell.css("background-image", "")
      cell.css("background-color", "")
      cell.text("")
    },
    update: function () {
      return
      // ***********************************************************************************************************
      // This is what's breaking the grid
      // ***********************************************************************************************************
     
      //
      // Hide any Dev divs
      //
      if (isDevMode) {
        $(".Dev").show()
      } else {
        $(".Dev").hide()
      }
      // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // Colour the manifest
      // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // Each Manifest Booking
      //
      // colour any that match what's on the board
      let plottedBookings = theBoard.getPlottedBookings()
      //
      //
      $(".Manifest").each(function () {
        let json = $(this).data("json")
        for (let b in plottedBookings) {
          for (let j in json) {
            if (
              json[j].orderNumber &&
              json[j].orderNumber == plottedBookings[b]
            ) {
              $(this).css("background", "#292e4a")
            }
          }
        }
      })
   
      //
      // Blank out all unmarked cells (not tagged IN or OUT)
      //
      $(".TableCell").each(function () {
        //
        // Blank Cell if no json
        //
        let jsn = $(this).data("json")
        let _bookings = false
        let numInfants = 0
        //
        if (jsn && !jQuery.isEmptyObject(jsn)) {
          _bookings = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(jsn))
        } else {
          $(this).removeData("type")
          $(this).css("background", "")
          $(this).css("background-image", "")
          let plane = display.getPlane($(this))
          $(this).css("background-color", plane.color)
          $(this).css("background-color", "")
          $(this).html("<br></br>")
        }
        let hasData = false
        //
        // Combine matching booking orderNumbers
        //
        let newObj = {}
        // -------------------------------------------
        // _bookings... a JSON array of booking objects
        // -------------------------------------------
        //
        // First pass over _bookings, combine matching products...
        //
        for (let bk in _bookings) {
          //
          // Each Booking
          //
          if (_bookings[bk] && _bookings[bk].orderNumber) {
            //
            // Has Infants?
            //
            if (_bookings[bk].ACI && _bookings[bk].ACI.length > 2) {
              numInfants += _bookings[bk].ACI[2]
            }
            //
            // Combine pax (back into master key)
            //
            let orderNumber = _bookings[bk].orderNumber.split("_")[0]
            //
            if (newObj[orderNumber]) {
              let obj1 = newObj[orderNumber]
              let obj2 = _bookings[bk]
              let paxObjList = {}
              // transform pax list into pax hashtable
              for (let px1 in obj1.pax) {
                if (obj1.pax[px1].key) {
                  let key1 = obj1.pax[px1].key
                  if (!paxObjList[key1]) {
                    paxObjList[key1] = obj1.pax[px1]
                  }
                }
              }
              for (let px in obj2.pax) {
                if (obj2.pax[px].key) {
                  let key = obj2.pax[px].key
                  if (!paxObjList[key]) {
                    paxObjList[key] = obj2.pax[px]
                  }
                }
              }
              obj1.pax = []
              for (let p in paxObjList) {
                obj1.pax.push(paxObjList[p])
              }
              newObj[orderNumber] = obj1
            } else {
              newObj[orderNumber] = _bookings[bk]
            }
          }
        }
        //
        // convert hashtable back to array and overwrite _bookings array with it.
        //
        let newArray = []
        for (let b in newObj) {
          newArray.push(newObj[b])
        }
        _bookings = newArray
        for (bk in _bookings) {
          if (_bookings[bk] && _bookings[bk].orderNumber) {
            hasData = true
          }
        }
        // -------------------------
        // Second Pass over _bookings
        // -------------------------
        //
        // Write new json to cell
        //
        // Build the Table Cells...
        //
        $(this).data("json", _bookings)
        if (hasData) {
          $(this).data("highlighted", false)
          $(this).css("border", "")
          //
          // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          // Table Cell
          // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          //
          // Glenorchy Airstrip Pickup?
          //
          let isGY = false
          let outOfBalance = false
          let WB = wb.getBalance($(this))
          let _cg = WB.getCG()
          let _w = WB.getWeight()
          if (_cg < 0 || _w < 0 || isNaN(_cg) || isNaN(_w)) {
            outOfBalance = true
          }
          for (let b in _bookings) {
            if (
              _bookings[b].pickupLocation &&
              _bookings[b].pickupLocation.locationName
            ) {
              if (
                _bookings[b].pickupLocation.locationName.match(
                  /Glenorchy Airstrip/gi
                )
              ) {
                isGY = true
              }
            }
          }
          //
          // update the text
          //
          let seats = gya.getSeats(_bookings)
          if (seats) {
            let row = parseInt($(this).parent().prop("id"))

            let type = $(this).data("type") || false
            let direction = ""

            let c = colors.getByRow(_bookings[bk].IN) // colors.get( _bookings[bk].orderNumber ) // returns a color object based on the booking.
            let clrs = {
              bkin: "#E5E7E9",
              bkout: "#CCD1D1",
            }

            let inOut = type
            //
            // Glenorchy Leg
            //
            if (isGY) {
              inOut = "<B>GY</B>"
              c = "yellow"
              c = "yellow"
            }

            if (outOfBalance) {
              clrs.bkin = "red"
              clrs.bkout = "red"
            }
            let bkg = ""
            //let products = utility.getProducts( _bookings )

            //
            // Pax Product Block
            //
            let products = {}
            for (b in _bookings) {
              let B = _bookings[b]
              let product = B.product
              let numPax = B.pax.length
              if (!products[product]) {
                products[product] = numPax
              } else {
                products[product] = products[product] + numPax
              }
            }
            //
            //
            //
            let productString = ""
            for (p in products) {
              productString =
                productString +
                "<div><span style='font-size: x-small' class='PaxPerProduct'>" +
                products[p] +
                "</span> " +
                p +
                "</div>"
            }
            //
            // IN
            //
            if (type == "in") {
              $(this).addClass("inCell")
              bkg =
                "linear-gradient(-110deg, " + c + " 20%, " + clrs.bkin + " 20%)"
              $(this).css("background-image", bkg)
              direction =
                "<span class='inMarker'><div>" +
                inOut +
                "</div><div>&#8595;</div></span> " // IN
            }
            //
            // OUT
            //
            else if (type == "out") {
              $(this).addClass("outCell")
              bkg =
                "linear-gradient(110deg, " + clrs.bkout + " 80%, " + c + " 80%)" // out colors
              $(this).css("background-image", bkg)
              direction =
                "<span class='outMarker'><div>&#8593;</div><div>" +
                inOut +
                "</div></span> " // OUT
            }
            seats =
              '<span style="font-weight:bold; float: left; display: block;padding-right:5px;padding-left:2px"> ' +
              seats +
              "</span>"
            productString =
              '<span style="float: left;display: block;">' +
              productString +
              "</span>"

            let htmlString = direction + seats + productString
            $(this).html(htmlString)

            if (numInfants > 0) {
              let infantIcon = "<span class='circleIcon'>Inf</span>"
              $(this).prepend(infantIcon)
            }
          }
        }
      })
      $(".BookingSprite").each(function () {
        $(this).css("border", "")
      })
      //
      // Ferry Legs
      //
      theBoard.highlightFerryLegs()
      //
      // Pickups
      //
      theBoard.showPickups()
    },
    bookingsToHTML: function (bookings) {
      let ret = ""
      let booking = bookings[0] // there's only ever one booking
      ret += booking.pax.length
      ret += booking.product
      return ret
    },
    clearBoard: function () {
      console.log("display.clearBoard()")
      $(".TableCell").each(function () {
        let element = $(this)
        element.css("background-color", "white")
        element.removeData("json")
        element.removeData("type")
        element.text("")
      })
      $(".BookingSprite")
        .draggable("enable")
        .css("background-color", "lightblue")
      //display.update()
    },
    // ---------------
    // Remove _bookings
    // ---------------
    removeBooking: function (key, source) {
      // Each TableCell: remove matching keys
      // Remove from source
      $(".TableCell").each(function (index) {
        //
        // Each TableCell
        //
        let list = $(this).data("json")
        //
        // list is an array of booking objects
        //
        if (list) {
          //
          // Use a copy
          //
          let tableBookingList = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(list))
          //
          // Each Booking Object
          //
          for (let i in tableBookingList) {
            //
            let booking = tableBookingList[i]
            //
            // Each Pax in the table
            //
            for (let p in booking.pax) {
              if (booking.pax[p].key == key) {
                if (
                  source.data("type") == "out" &&
                  $(this).data("type") != "out"
                ) {
                  break
                }
                booking.pax.splice(p, 1)
              }
            }
            //
            // If no pax are left, remove the booking from the cell
            //
            if (booking.pax.length < 1) {
              tableBookingList.splice(i, 1)
            }
          }
          if (tableBookingList.length < 1) {
            $(this).removeData("json")
            $(this).removeData("type")
            $(this).text(null)
          } else {
            $(this).data("json", tableBookingList)
          }
        }
      })
    },
    //
    // Change to remove bookings one by one *********************************************
    // Will need same removeData code for when the last booking is removed.
    //
    removeBookings: function (bookings, sourceCell) {
      //
      // Each booking (list of pax)
      //
      for (b in bookings) {
        if (!!bookings[b] && bookings[b].orderNumber) {
          let key = bookings[b].orderNumber || null
          if (key) {
            //
            // Each Table Cells
            //
            $(".TableCell").each(function (index) {
              //
              // Each booking in the TableCell's json array
              //
              let list = $(this).data("json")
              let type = $(this).data("type")
              // skip if no JSON
              if (list) {
                //
                // Remove Null
                //
                list = list.filter(function (el) {
                  return el != null
                })
                //
                // operate on a copy
                //
                let tableBookingList = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(list))
                //
                // Compare each TableCell booking with each one passed in
                //
                tableBookingList.forEach(function (value, i) {
                  //
                  // Skip Blanks
                  //
                  if (!!value && !!value.orderNumber) {
                    if (key == value.orderNumber) {
                      tableBookingList.splice(i, 1)
                    }
                  }
                })
                $(this).data("json", tableBookingList)

                if (jQuery.isEmptyObject(tableBookingList)) {
                  display.clearCell($(this))
                }
              }
            })
          }
        }
      }
      //display.update()
    },
  }
</script>

function handleOverEvent(event, ui){

    let source = ui.draggable
    let newBookings = source.data("json")
    let inCell = $(this)
    let inCellBookings = inCell.data("json")
    let returnTripTarget = {}
   
    // Objects to hold the list of in and out cells (ins should all be the current cell)
    let outs = {}
    let ins = {}

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // calcultate IN/OUT
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    for (b in newBookings){
      let booking = newBookings[b]
      if (booking && booking.orderNumber){
          let INOUT = utility.getTarget(inCell,booking) // Array [[IN,OUT]] cells (Coordinate IDs)
          if(!INOUT){return} // =================== If null, exit ===================
          let inKey = INOUT[0].join("")
          utility.pushKey(ins,inKey,booking) // Push cell keys into the "ins" object list (creates arrays key'd on in cell coordinates)
          let outKey = INOUT[1].join("")
          utility.pushKey(outs,outKey,booking) // Push cell keys into the "outs" object list (creates arrays key'd on out cell coordinates)
       }
    }
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Set IN Cell
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Everything added will have the same IN Cell, so we'll use that instead of looping
    inCell = $("#" + Object.keys(ins)[0])
    inCellBookings = inCell.data("json")
    inCell.data("baseStyle",inCell.attr("style")) // Capture pre-highlight style
    let border = "3px dashed yellow"
    
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Highlight
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  let highlighted = inCell.data('highlighted') || false
  if (!highlighted){ // Not yet highlighted
    inCell.css({
      border: border,
    })
    inCell.data('highlighted',true)
  }  
  
  for (cell in outs){
    let outCell = $("#"+cell) // Key

    // Capture pre-highlight style
    let preStyle = outCell.attr("style")
    if (preStyle == ""){
      delete preStyle
    }
    outCell.data("baseStyle",preStyle) 
    
    highlighted = outCell.data('highlighted') || false
    if (!highlighted){ // Not yet highlighted
        outCell.css({
          "border": "3px dashed green",
      })
      outCell.data('highlighted',true)
    }
  
  }




}
function handleOutEvent(event, ui){
   
    let source = ui.draggable
    let newBookings = source.data("json")
    let inCell = $(this)
    let inCellBookings = inCell.data("json")
    let returnTripTarget = {}
   
    // Objects to hold the list of in and out cells (ins should all be the current cell)
    let outs = {}
    let ins = {}

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // calcultate IN/OUT and brand the booking
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    for (b in newBookings){
      let booking = newBookings[b]
      if (booking && booking.orderNumber){
          let INOUT = utility.getTarget(inCell,booking) // Array [[IN,OUT]] cells (Coordinate IDs)
          if(!INOUT){return} // =================== If null, exit ===================
          let inKey = INOUT[0].join("")
          utility.pushKey(ins,inKey,booking) // Push cell keys into the "ins" object list (creates arrays key'd on in cell coordinates)
          let outKey = INOUT[1].join("")
          utility.pushKey(outs,outKey,booking) // Push cell keys into the "outs" object list (creates arrays key'd on out cell coordinates)
       }
    }
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Target IN Cell
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Everything added will have the same IN Cell, so we'll use that instead of looping
    inCell = $("#" + Object.keys(ins)[0])
    
    // Remove Highlighting
   let highlighted = inCell.data('highlighted') || false      
      
   if (highlighted){
     inCell.data('highlighted',false)
        
     let revertStyle = inCell.data("baseStyle") || false
     if (!revertStyle){
       inCell.removeAttr("style")
     } else {
       inCell.attr("style",revertStyle)
     }
     // revert the out cells
      for (cell in outs){
      
        let outCell = $("#"+cell) // Key
        outCell.data('highlighted',false)
            
        if (typeof outCell.data("baseStyle") != 'undefined'){
    
           revertStyle = outCell.data("baseStyle") || false
           if (!revertStyle){
             outCell.removeAttr("style")
           } else {
             outCell.attr("style",revertStyle)
           }
        }
        else { 
          outCell.removeAttr("style")
        }
      }
   }         
}

function handleTrashDrop(event, ui) {
  //
  // Hide the sprite
  ui.helper.hide()
  //
  // Reset Booking List Object
  //
  $(".BookingSprite").each(function() {
     //
     let json = ui.draggable.data("json")
     for ( a in json){
       if (json[a].orderNumber){
         $("#" + json[a].orderNumber).css("background", "lightgrey")
       }
     }
     
  })
  //
  // Remove the bookings from the board
  //

}
////////////////
//  Drop
////////////////
function handleDropEvent(event, ui) {
    
    let isBookingSprite = ui.draggable.prop("class").includes("BookingSprite")
    let isPopupSprite = ui.draggable.prop("class").includes("PopupSprite")
    let isPaxSprite = ui.draggable.prop("class").includes("PaxSprite")
    let isTableCell = ui.draggable.prop("class").includes("TableCell")
    let isPlaneCell = $(this).prop("class").includes("PlaneCell")
    let isOUT = ui.draggable.data("type") == "out"? true:false // [in,out,null]
        
    let DroppedBookings = ui.draggable.data("json")
    let sourceCell = ui.draggable
    
    let targetID = $(this).prop("id")
    let sourceID = ui.draggable.prop("id")
    if (isPopupSprite){
      sourceID = ui.draggable.data("sourceID")
    }
    
    let targetCell = $(this.element)   
    let targetCellBookings = targetCell.data("json")
    let returnTripTarget = {}
    
    // Objects to hold the list of in and out cells (ins should all be the current cell)
    var outs = {}
    var ins = {}
    var oldOuts = {}
    //
    // Reject Outs dropped on Plane Cells
    // This could also be done with jQuery (change the class) **************
    // We would lose the ability to notify though ************** (unless jQuery handles that... hrm... I think it does) ************
    if (isPlaneCell && isOUT){
      utility.alert("PlaneCells don't accept outs")
      return
    }
    //
    // Remove all other previously dropped bookings
    //    
    if (isPaxSprite || isPopupSprite){
      //
      for (let b in DroppedBookings){
        let booking = DroppedBookings[b]
        if (booking){
          for (let a in booking.pax){
            let key = booking.pax[a].key
            display.removeBooking(key,sourceCell)
          }
        }
      }
    } else if (isBookingSprite){
        for(let b in DroppedBookings){
          let booking = DroppedBookings[b]
          //
          // Skip null
          //
          if (!!booking.orderNumber){
            let id = booking.orderNumber.split("_")[0]
            display.removeBookings(DroppedBookings,sourceCell)
          }
        }
    }
    //
    // Find the target cell and build ins/outs arrays based on booking data
    // Depends on if it's dropped on the PlaneCell / BookingCell
    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Build lists of ins/outs
    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    for (b in DroppedBookings){
      let booking = DroppedBookings[b]
      if (booking.orderNumber){
      
      
      // Is it an out? ***************************
      // TableCells are key'd with "type" (in/out)
      // Manifest Cells? (BookingSprite)

      //
      // Start with the old bookings
      // What are we bringing with the dropped cell? (if anything)
      
      // we only calculate the outs if it's a BookingSprite
      // Otherwise we drag the outs along with us (if they exist)
      
      // We'll handle outs the same as booking sprite drops for now (no need to calculate anything) *****?
      
      // Table Cell IN drops (not outs)
      if (isTableCell && !isOUT){
        let ID = $(this).attr('id')
        let inKey = ID
        let row = theBoard.getRow($(this))
        let col = theBoard.getCol($(this))
        //
        // 1st, what is the old cell?       
        // if it's an in, where are the out cells for those bookings?
        let inOut = utility.getTarget(ui.draggable,booking)
        // inOut[0] is the in
        // inOut[1] is the out
        // inOut[2] is the offset  
        let offset = inOut[2]
        let newRow = row+offset
        //
        // 3rd, does the out still exist or has it moved?
        // If it exists, push the outs and oldOuts
        //
        let theOutKey = inOut[1].join("")
        let theOutCell = $("#"+theOutKey)
        //
        // Look through the old booking cells. If the out is there, add it to the old outs list.
        //
        let oldBookings = theOutCell.data('json')
        if (oldBookings){
          for (b in oldBookings){
            //
            // Match
            //
            if (!!oldBookings[b].orderNumber && !!booking.orderNumber){
              if(oldBookings[b].orderNumber == booking.orderNumber){
                let outKey = ""+newRow+col
                if(isOUT){ outKey = inKey } // If it's a dropped out, swap the inKey for the outKey (dropped outs only have inKeys)
                utility.pushKey(outs,outKey,booking)
                utility.pushKey(oldOuts,theOutKey,booking)
              }
            }
          }
        }
        //
        // Push the in Key
        //
        if (!isOUT){
          utility.pushKey(ins,inKey,booking)
        }
      }
      // -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // BookingSprite dropps need the in/out calculated
      // -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      if ( isBookingSprite || isOUT) {
        //
        // an out product will only send back an OUT array (the IN will be blank)
        //
        let INOUT = utility.getTarget($(this),booking) // Array [[IN,OUT,offset]] cells (Coordinate IDs)
        console.log("INOUT: %o",INOUT)
        if(!INOUT){return} // =================== If null, exit ===================
        //
        let inKey = INOUT[0].join("")
        let outKey = INOUT[1].join("")
        let offset = INOUT[2]
        //
        // is the drop branded IN? 
        //
        if (!isOUT){ 
            utility.pushKey(ins,inKey,booking)
            utility.pushKey(outs,outKey,booking)
          } else {
            // If it's an out, push the __inKey__ into the __outs__
            if(inKey){
              utility.pushKey(outs,inKey,booking)
            } else {
              utility.pushKey(outs,outKey,booking)            
            }
          }
          //
          // If it's an out, brand everything out.
          //
          if (isOUT || inKey.length<1){
            if (isOUT && ui.draggable.data("type")=="in"){ // if there's outs in an IN drop, there's a problem... exit.
              utility.error("INOUT Error")
              return
            } 
            isOUT = true // If anything's going out, it's all going out.
          }
      }
     }
    }
    // ----------------- End Dropped Bookings loop -----------------------------

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Check IN-OUT. Make sure it's a legal drop.
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    for (a in ins){
      let type = $("#"+a).data("type")
      if (type == "out"){
        let msg = "In/Out Conflict"
        utility.error(msg,ins[a])
        return
      }
    }
    for (a in outs){
      let type = $("#"+a).data("type")
      if (type == "in"){
        let msg = "In/Out Conflict"
        utility.error(msg,outs[a])
        return
      }
    }

    let InOut = ins
    let InOutType = "in"
    if(isOUT){
      InOut = outs
      InOutType = "out"
    }
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // IN Cell
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    for (i in InOut){
      for(b in InOut[i]){
        if (InOut[i][b].orderNumber){ // skip blanks
          targetCell = $("#" + i)
          if (targetCell.data('type')){
            if (targetCell.data('type')!=InOutType){
              let msg = "Wrong Type: " + InOutType + " Cell Type: " + targetCell.data('type')
              utility.error(msg)
              return
            }
          }
          targetCell.data('type', InOutType) // brand the cell
          break // Should only be one IN so we'll break the loop
        }
      }
    }
    // ------------------
    // Merge IN Cell JSON
    // ------------------
    let merge = typeof targetCell.data('json') !== 'undefined' ? true : false
    if (merge && targetCell.data('json')==null){merge=false}
    //
    let obj = {};
    if (merge) {
        obj = targetCell.data('json')
        if (obj){
          for (j in ui.draggable.data('json')){
            obj = obj.concat(ui.draggable.data('json')[j])
          }
        }
    } else {
        obj = ui.draggable.data('json')
    }
    
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Disable Sprite
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    ui.helper.hide()
    
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // tag JSON with coordinates
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    let myIn
    for (i in ins){
      myIn = i
      break
    }
    for (a in obj){
      obj[a].tripCell = targetCell.attr("id")
      for ( i in ins){
        obj[a].IN = myIn
      }
    }
   
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Mark grid
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // targetCell.text(totalSeats)
    targetCell.data('json', obj)    
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Mark the OUTs of the INs
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // outs is a list of out cell ID's with the value of an array of booking objects
    // (already branded JSON)
    if(!isOUT){
      //
      for (cell in outs){ // cell is the coordinate
        let outCell = $("#"+cell) // Key
        let bookingList = outs[cell] // Value (array of booking objects)
        let merge = typeof outCell.data('json') !== 'undefined' ? true : false // Check for existing bookings in the target cell
            
        let obj = {}
        obj = outCell.data('json')
        
        if (merge && obj!=null) {

            for (j in bookingList){
              obj = obj.concat(bookingList[j])
            }
    
        } else {
            obj = bookingList
        }
        for ( b in obj){
              obj[b].IN = myIn
        }
        outCell.data('json', obj)
        outCell.data('type', 'out') // brand the cell
      }
    }
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Cleanup
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    if (!isOUT && isTableCell){
    // {key:bookings[],key:bookings[]}
    let ary = oldOuts // hashtable of booking arrays key'd by source cell coordinates
      for (key in ary){
        for(i in ary[key]){
          //
          // Each Key
          //
            // If array booking == cell booking, remove it from the cell
            let cell = $("#"+key)
            let cj = cell.data('json')
            // loop through the list of bookings and remove matches
            for (o in cj){
              if (cj[o].orderNumber){
                if (!!ary[key][i].orderNumber){
                  if (cj[o].orderNumber == ary[key][i].orderNumber){
                    delete(cj[o])
                  }
                }
              }
            }

            if ( jQuery.isEmptyObject(cell.data('json')) ){
              cell.removeData('json')
              cell.removeData('type')
              cell.text(null)            
            }   
        }
      }
    }
    if (ui.draggable.prop("class").includes("TableCell")) {
        //
        // Clear the old cell
        //
        //ui.draggable.css("background-color", "white")
        ui.draggable.text("")
        ui.draggable.data('json',null)                                          /// maybe just flag for removal??????
        ui.draggable.data('type',null) // Remove IN/OUT branding
        targetCell.draggable('enable', "helper", "clone")
    }
    //display.update()
    if(isPopupSprite){
      bookingManager.getDetails(ui.draggable,sourceID)
    }
}

<script>
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Global variables (most can/should be moved into a root object instead)
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  var isLive = false
  var isMobile = false // ( set to true for testing)
  // ******************** This can move **************************
  var style = "compact" //("compact","verbose") // global style (for BookingSprite at the moment)
  //
  // isMobile
  //
  if (/Mobi|Android/i.test(navigator.userAgent)) {
    isMobile = true
  }
  //
  // isLive (unreliable)
  //
  if (/glenorchyair\.co\.nz/i.test(window.location.href)) {
    isLive = true
  }

  //*******************************************************************************************************************************
  // Testing:
  //  isMobile = true
  //*******************************************************************************************************************************
  //
  // setDevMode is called when launching via a Spreadsheet
  // This lets us turn things on and off like "Close" buttons (which don't work in browsers)
  //
  var isDevMode = false
  function setDevMode(data) {
    isDevMode = data.text
  }

  // ------------------------------------Mouse--------------------------------------------------------
  //
  // Setup "mouse" for use with mobile
  //
  /*
    Mobile (Android Chrome) can't do both drag and click on the same element (Touch Punch plugin), 
    so we capture the mouse In/Out events and compare them. If they're similar, it's a click.
    This is a mobile only thing so we check isMobile for true
  */
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  let mouse = {
    over: {
      x: 0,
      y: 0,
    },
    out: {
      x: 0,
      y: 0,
    },
    clear: function () {
      this.over.x = 0
      this.over.y = 0
    },
    setOver: function (x, y) {
      this.over.x = x
      this.over.y = y
    },
    isClick: function (x, y) {
      let ret = false
      let difX = x - this.over.x
      let difY = y - this.over.y
      difX = Math.abs(difX)
      difX = Math.abs(difX)
      if (difX < 20 && difY < 20) {
        ret = true
      }
      this.clear()
      return ret
    },
  }
  // ----------------------------------End Mouse----------------------------------------------------------
</script>
<script>
  var gya = {
    //STND_Extra:4, // extra kg to add to a standard weight declaration
    standard: {
      declared_bonus: 4,
      adult: 83,
      child: 46,
      infant: 15,
    },
    trips: [], // Range loaded from spreadsheet via loadTripCodes()
    //
    // Called by Rezdy function, loaded values from the spreadsheet.
    //
    onTripCodeLoad: function (data) {
      gya.trips = data
    },
    //
    // Get code translations (from TripCodes sheet)
    //
    getProduct: function (product) {
      //
      // Takes a Rezdy Product Code and returns an array (row loaded from the spreadsheet)
      //
      //
      // Find the colum that's titled "RezdyCode"
      //
      let col = 0
      for (let c in this.trips[0]) {
        let regex = new RegExp("^RezdyCode", "gi")
        if (this.trips[0][c].match(regex)) {
          col = c
        }
      }
      //
      // search "trips" range(loaded from Spreadsheet) for the Rezdy code and return that row as an object (key'd by the header row)
      //
      for (let row in this.trips) {
        if (this.trips[row][col].match(product)) {
          let product = {}
          for (let col in this.trips[row]) {
            product[this.trips[0][col]] = this.trips[row][col]
          }
          return product
        }
      }
      return "|NoCode|"
    },
    //
    getOffset: function (product) {
      let col = 0
      let durationCol = 0
      for (let c in this.trips[0]) {
        let regex = new RegExp("^RezdyCode", "gi")
        if (this.trips[0][c].match(regex)) {
          col = c
        }
        let reg = new RegExp("^Duration", "gi")
        if (this.trips[0][c].match(reg)) {
          durationCol = c
        }
      }
      let offset = 0
      // search "trips" array(2d) and return the offset
      for (row in this.trips) {
        let regex = new RegExp("^" + product, "gi")
        if (this.trips[row][col].match(regex)) {
          return parseInt(this.trips[row][durationCol]) // trip duration
        }
      }
      return offset
    },
    // Accepts array of booking objects
    // returns total number of occupied seats (Adults and Children, skips infants) ****** Need to write the skip infants part ***************
    //
    // Accepts [{Booking},{Booking}]
    //
    getSeats: function (Bookings) {
      let totalSeats = 0
      for (b in Bookings) {
        let booking = Bookings[b]
        // Skip extraneous things like _proto_
        /// Use ACI if seats doesn't match the # of passengers

        if (booking.pax) {
          let bookingSeats = parseInt(booking.pax.length)

          //let _aciNum = arrays.sum(booking.ACI,2)

          if (bookingSeats > 0) {
            totalSeats += bookingSeats
          }
        }
      }
      return totalSeats
    },
    getCode(Bookings) {
      let ret
      for (let b in Bookings){
        
      }
      let initialValue = 0
      let sum = Bookings.reduce(function (accumulator, currentValue) {
        return accumulator + currentValue.x
      }, initialValue)
    },
  }
