    let endurance = WB.fuel / WB.Burn
    _plane.Endurance = {}
    _plane.Endurance.hour = Math.floor(Math.abs(endurance))
    _plane.Endurance.min = Math.floor((Math.abs(endurance) * 60) % 60)
    _plane.Endurance.decimal = endurance

    // ****************************************************************************************
    // Clear out the old data
    // ****************************************************************************************
    _trip.route = null
    _trip.routes = null
    _trip.cruiseCount = null
    if (loadsheetData._cruiseCount > 0) {
      _trip.cruiseCount = "Total Cruising Pax: " + loadsheetData._cruiseCount
      if (loadsheetData._infantCount > 0) {
        _trip.cruiseCount =
          _trip.cruiseCount + " (infant:" + loadsheetData._infantCount + ")"
      }
    }

    _paxList = []
    //      _loadsheetData = []
    _Loadsheet = {}
    FF = false
    _trip.pax = []
    _trip.paxW = []

    _plane.copilot = ""
    _plane.copilotSpan = ""
    _plane.reg = WB.reg
    _plane.regColor = WB.regColor
    _plane.type = WB.type
    _plane.fuel = Math.round(WB.fuel)
    _plane.AEW = Math.round(WB.wam[0][0])
    _plane.ZFW = Math.round(WB.ZFW)
    _plane.fuelWeight = Math.round(WB.fuelWeight)
    _plane.MCTOW = WB.MCTOW
    _plane.TOW = Math.round(WB.TOW)
    _plane.CGLimit = WB.maxCG[1] // Just aft for now **********************

    _plane.CG = Math.round(WB.getCG() * 100) / 100
    _plane.totalPaxWeight = WB.tPaxW

    _plane.std = "Weights Standard"
    if (WB.all_weights) {
      _plane.std = "Weight Declared"
    }
    // Trip Time
    _trip.date = $("#datepicker").val()
    $("._tripDate").html(_trip.date)
    let tripTime = theBoard.get4DigitTime(_this) // 02:00
    $("._trip_time").html(theBoard.getTripTime(_this))
    _trip.time = tripTime

    //
    //
    //

    //
    // Product Codes
    //
    // ******************** distinguish in or out code *********************************
    let productCodes = {}
    for (let b in JSON) {
      for (let pc in JSON[b].productCode) {
        // product code row from spreadsheet
        let code = JSON[b].productCode
        if (!productCodes[code[4]]) {
          // match the code
          productCodes[code[4]] = code[4]
        }
        if (code[6] && code[6].match(/Yes/gi)) {
          FF = true
        }
      }
    }
    // ********** Need to rename these productCodes to route codes as they're not productCodes *******************
    let _pc = []
    let _count = 0
    for (let p in productCodes) {
      let code = productCodes[p]
      if (_count > 0) {
        code = " <span style='font-size:x-small'>[" + code + "]</span>"
      }
      _pc.push(code)
      _count++
    }
    _trip.route = _pc.join(" ")
    _trip.routes = Object.keys(productCodes).join(" ")
    $("._trip_route").html(_trip.route)
    $("._trip_cruiseCount").html(_trip.cruiseCount)
    //
    // This could all be done earlier, maybe in parse rezdy **********************
    //
    for (let a in WB.seats) {
      // seats: [weight,{seatobj}]
      let data = WB.seats[a] // [weight, {pax}]

      // skip crew, process pax
      //
      // Crew will only be [weight, name] rather than [weight, {}]
      //
      if (data && data.length > 0 && typeof data[1] != "string") {
        let w = data[0]
        let pax = data[1]

        let FN = "(" + a + ") " + pax.firstName
        let LN = pax.lastName

        let extra = ""
        if (pax.extra) {
          let _extra = pax.extra.name
          if (_extra) {
            _extra = _extra.split("(")[0]
            extra = " [ " + _extra + " ] "
          }
        }
        let FULLN = FN + " " + LN + extra

        // GY Airstrip
        pax.pickup = "" // Blank otherwise it persists between Loadsheets
        if (
          pax.pickupLocation &&
          pax.pickupLocation.locationName &&
          pax.pickupLocation.locationName.match(/Glenorchy Airstrip/gi)
        ) {
          pax.pickup = "GY"
        }
        if (
          pax.pickupLocation &&
          pax.pickupLocation.locationName &&
          pax.pickupLocation.locationName.match(/Blanket/gi)
        ) {
          pax.pickup = "GY"
        }
        if (
          pax.productCode &&
          pax.productCode[2] &&
          pax.productCode[2].match(/\-DR/gi)
        ) {
          pax.pickup = "<span style='font-size:x-small'>DropGY</span>"
        }

        _paxList.push({
          bgColor: "white",
          firstName: FN,
          lastName: LN,
          fullName: FULLN,
          weight: w,
          product: pax.product,
          productCode: pax.productCode,
          pickupLocation: pax.pickupLocation,
          pickup: pax.pickup,
        })
      }

      //
      // Need the pilot and copilot to process first in the stack ******************************
      //
      if (data && data.length > 0 && typeof data[1] == "string") {
        if (a == 0) {
          _plane.pilot = data[1]
          _plane.crewWeight = data[0]
        }
        // Copilot
        if (a > 0) {
          if (typeof data[1] == "string") {
            let cp =
              "<span style='font-size:small'> (copilot: " + data[1] + ")</span>"
            _plane.copilot = data[1]
            _plane.copilotSpan = cp
            _plane.crewWeight += data[0]
          } else {
            _plane.copilot = ""
          }
        }
      }
      // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // Put objects into variables for display
      // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      $(".reg").css("background-color", _plane.regColor)
      $("._plane_pilot").html(_plane.pilot)
      //
      // Pilot Info (for FF)
      //
      //console.log("Matrix: %o", pilots.matrix)
      let pilotData = ""
      for (let a in pilots.matrix) {
        let p = pilots.matrix[a]
        let re = new RegExp(_plane.pilot, "ig")
        if (p[0] && p[0].match(re)) {
          pilotData = p
        }
      }
      if (pilotData && pilotData.length > 2) {
        $(".PIC_Phone").html(pilotData[2])
      }
      /*
          Burnoff : 75,
          LandingWeight : 1800,
          OutOfLimits : "",
          KGLBS:"KG",
          totalPaxWeight:166,
          totalFreightWeight:0,
          totalBagWeight:0
          */
    }
    // Display Pilot and Plane
    $("#pilot_name").html(WB.seats[0][1])

    //
    // Load _plane object into classes
    //
    for (let i in _plane) {
      $("._plane_" + i).html(_plane[i])
    }

    // Display Pax (Will need update for Caravan) ******************************************

    //
    // Clear out old values
    //
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
      $("._paxList-" + i + "-fullName").html("")
      $("._paxList-" + i + "-weight").html("")
      $("._paxList-" + i + "-product").html("")
      $("._paxList-" + i + "-pickup").html("")
    }
    // Flatten PaxList
    for (let i in _paxList) {
      for (let o in _paxList[i]) {
        $("._paxList-" + i + "-" + o).html(_paxList[i][o])
      }
    }
    // Flight Data V1 format:
    // date,time,pilot,plane,fuel,route,pax,paxWeights,pilotWeight,TOW,CG,numPax
    for (let px in _paxList) {
      let tis = _paxList[px].firstName + " " + _paxList[px].lastName
      let tat = _paxList[px].weight
      _trip.pax.push(tis)
      _trip.paxW.push(tat)
    }
    _trip.paxNames = _trip.pax.join(",")
    _trip.paxWeights = _trip.paxW.join(",")
    // Populate loadsheet data for printing
    _Loadsheet = {
      date: _trip.date,
      time: _trip.time,
      pilot: _plane.pilot,
      reg: _plane.reg,
      fuel: _plane.fuel,
      routes: _trip.routes,
      paxNames: _trip.paxNames,
      paxWeights: _trip.paxWeights,
      crewWeight: _plane.crewWeight,
      TOW: _plane.TOW,
      CG: _plane.CG,
      numPax: WB.numPax,
      copilot: _plane.copilot,
    }
    _loadsheetData = [
      _trip.date,
      _trip.time,
      _plane.pilot,
      _plane.reg,
      _plane.fuel,
      _trip.routes,
      _trip.paxNames,
      _trip.paxWeights,
      _plane.crewWeight,
      _plane.TOW,
      _plane.CG,
      WB.numPax,
    ]
    $("#details").hide()
    $("#planeDetails").hide()
    $("#Loadsheet").show()

    $("#FlightFollowing").hide()
    if (FF == true) {
      console.log("Seats: %o", WB.seats.length)
      $(".POB").html(WB.seats.length)
      $(".plane_Endurance_hour").html(_plane.Endurance.hour)
      $(".plane_Endurance_min").html(_plane.Endurance.min)
      $("#FlightFollowing").show()
    }
  }

  //var FF = true
  // some placeholder variables
  var _plane = {
    pilot: "[Pilot]",
    reg: "[REG]",
    type: "[GA8]",
    regColor: "white",
    fuel: "[75]", // Liters
    AEW: "",
    ZFW: "",
    fuelWeight: "[100]",
    MCTOW: 0,
    TOW: 0,
    Burnoff: "",
    LandingWeight: "",
    CGLimit: 0,
    CG: 0,
    OutOfLimits: "",
    crewWeight: 0,
    KGLBS: "[KG]",
    totalPaxWeight: 0,
    totalFreightWeight: "",
    totalBagWeight: "",
  }
  var _trip = {
    date: "1/12/2019",
    time: "08:00",
    route: "",
    pax: [],
    paxW: [],
  }
  var _paxList = []
  var _loadsheetData = []
</script>

<script>
  class Loadsheet {
    constructor($this) {
      const _this = this
      this._this = this
      this.$this = $this
      $this.data("object", this)
    }
    print() {
      return "HI"
    }
    show(_TableCell) {
      let LoadedPlane = _TableCell.getLoadedAirplane()
      console.log("{Loadsheet}.show() LoadedPlane: ", LoadedPlane)
      const LoadedWB = LoadedPlane.getWB()
      console.log("LoadedWB", LoadedWB)
      let seats = _TableCell.getSeats()
      console.log("{Loadsheet} seats:", seats)

      //$("#FlightFollowing").hide()

      //
      // Clear out old values
      //
      for (let i = 0; i < 11; i++) {
        $("._paxList-" + i + "-fullName").html("")
        $("._paxList-" + i + "-weight").html("")
      }
      const _plane = {
        pilot: "[Pilot]",
        reg: "[REG]",
        type: "[GA8]",
        regColor: "white",
        fuel: "[75]", // Liters
        AEW: "",
        ZFW: "",
        fuelWeight: "[100]",
        MCTOW: 0,
        TOW: 0,
        Burnoff: "",
        LandingWeight: "",
        CGLimit: 0,
        CG: 0,
        OutOfLimits: "",
        crewWeight: 0,
        KGLBS: "[KG]",
        totalPaxWeight: 0,
        totalFreightWeight: "",
        totalBagWeight: "",
      }

      // *********** Merge the two objects instead of copying the same names over? *************
      _plane.reg = LoadedPlane.reg
      _plane.regcolor = LoadedPlane.regcolor
      _plane.type = LoadedPlane.type

      $(".reg").css("background-color", LoadedPlane.regcolor)

      
      // Adjust seatNum if there's co-pilots *********************
      let seatNum = 0
      seats.map((station) => {
        if (!!station.pax) {
          const firstName = station.pax.find((px) => px.label == "First Name").value
          const lastName = station.pax.find((px) => px.label == "Last Name").value
          const regex = new RegExp("weight", "gi")
          const weight = station.pax.find((px) => px.label.match(regex)).value

          const role = station.pax.find((px) => px.label == "Role")
          if (!!role) {
                          let _crew
            switch (role.value) {
              case "PIC":
                _crew = firstName + " " + lastName
                _plane.pilot = _crew
                //$("._plane_pilot").html(_crew)
                break
              case "SIC":
                _crew = " / " + firstName + " " + lastName
                _plane.copilot = _crew
                //$("._plane_copilot").html(_crew)
                break
            }
            return
          } else {
            $("._paxList-" + seatNum + "-fullName").html(firstName + " " + lastName)
            $("._paxList-" + seatNum + "-weight").html(weight)
          }
          seatNum++
        }
      })
      // Flatten PaxList
      // for (let i in _paxList) {
      //   for (let o in _paxList[i]) {
      //     $("._paxList-" + i + "-" + o).html(_paxList[i][o])
      //   }
      // }
      

      //LoadedPlane //
      //
      // Load _plane object into classes
      //
      for (let i in _plane) {
        $("._plane_" + i).html(_plane[i])
      }

      let FF = true
      if (FF == true) {
        console.log("Seats: %o", seats.length)
        $(".POB").html(seats.length)
        // $(".plane_Endurance_hour").html(_plane.Endurance.hour)
        // $(".plane_Endurance_min").html(_plane.Endurance.min)
        $("#FlightFollowing").show()
      }

      this.$this.show()
    }
  }
</script>
<script>
  // ******************************************************************
  // (remove this) Object to hold loadsheet data (was sloppily used to quickly make loadsheet functions)
  // ******************************************************************
  let loadsheetData = {
    WB: null,
    _json: null,
    _this: null,
  }

  // ===============================
  // Loadsheet Close Button onClick
  // ===============================
  $("#printLoadsheetClose").click(function () {
    $("#Loadsheet").hide()
  })

  // ===============================
  // printLoadsheet()
  // ===============================
  function printLoadsheet() {
    let WB = loadsheetData.WB
    let JSON = loadsheetData._json
    let _this = loadsheetData._this

    console.log("PrintLoadsheet()")
    console.log("WB %o", WB)
    console.log("JSON %o", JSON)
    console.log("This %o", _this)
    console.log("Plane: %o", _plane)

    let endurance = WB.fuel / WB.Burn
    _plane.Endurance = {}
    _plane.Endurance.hour = Math.floor(Math.abs(endurance))
    _plane.Endurance.min = Math.floor((Math.abs(endurance) * 60) % 60)
    _plane.Endurance.decimal = endurance

    // ****************************************************************************************
    // Clear out the old data
    // ****************************************************************************************
    _trip.route = null
    _trip.routes = null
    _trip.cruiseCount = null
    if (loadsheetData._cruiseCount > 0) {
      _trip.cruiseCount = "Total Cruising Pax: " + loadsheetData._cruiseCount
      if (loadsheetData._infantCount > 0) {
        _trip.cruiseCount = _trip.cruiseCount + " (infant:" + loadsheetData._infantCount + ")"
      }
    }

    _paxList = []
    //      _loadsheetData = []
    _Loadsheet = {}
    FF = false
    _trip.pax = []
    _trip.paxW = []

    _plane.copilot = ""
    _plane.copilot = ""
    _plane.reg = WB.reg
    _plane.regColor = WB.regColor
    _plane.type = WB.type
    _plane.fuel = Math.round(WB.fuel)
    _plane.AEW = Math.round(WB.wam[0][0])
    _plane.ZFW = Math.round(WB.ZFW)
    _plane.fuelWeight = Math.round(WB.fuelWeight)
    _plane.MCTOW = WB.MCTOW
    _plane.TOW = Math.round(WB.TOW)
    _plane.CGLimit = WB.maxCG[1] // Just aft for now **********************

    _plane.CG = Math.round(WB.getCG() * 100) / 100
    _plane.totalPaxWeight = WB.tPaxW

    _plane.std = "Weights Standard"
    if (WB.all_weights) {
      _plane.std = "Weight Declared"
    }
    // Trip Time
    _trip.date = $("#datepicker").val()
    $("._tripDate").html(_trip.date)
    let tripTime = theBoard.get4DigitTime(_this) // 02:00
    $("._trip_time").html(theBoard.getTripTime(_this))
    _trip.time = tripTime

    //
    //
    //

    //
    // Product Codes
    //
    // ******************** distinguish in or out code *********************************
    let productCodes = {}
    for (let b in JSON) {
      for (let pc in JSON[b].productCode) {
        // product code row from spreadsheet
        let code = JSON[b].productCode
        if (!productCodes[code[4]]) {
          // match the code
          productCodes[code[4]] = code[4]
        }
        if (code[6] && code[6].match(/Yes/gi)) {
          FF = true
        }
      }
    }
    // ********** Need to rename these productCodes to route codes as they're not productCodes *******************
    let _pc = []
    let _count = 0
    for (let p in productCodes) {
      let code = productCodes[p]
      if (_count > 0) {
        code = " <span style='font-size:x-small'>[" + code + "]</span>"
      }
      _pc.push(code)
      _count++
    }
    _trip.route = _pc.join(" ")
    _trip.routes = Object.keys(productCodes).join(" ")
    $("._trip_route").html(_trip.route)
    $("._trip_cruiseCount").html(_trip.cruiseCount)
    //
    // This could all be done earlier, maybe in parse rezdy **********************
    //
    for (let a in WB.seats) {
      // seats: [weight,{seatobj}]
      let data = WB.seats[a] // [weight, {pax}]

      // skip crew, process pax
      //
      // Crew will only be [weight, name] rather than [weight, {}]
      //
      if (data && data.length > 0 && typeof data[1] != "string") {
        let w = data[0]
        let pax = data[1]

        let FN = "(" + a + ") " + pax.firstName
        let LN = pax.lastName

        let extra = ""
        if (pax.extra) {
          let _extra = pax.extra.name
          if (_extra) {
            _extra = _extra.split("(")[0]
            extra = " [ " + _extra + " ] "
          }
        }
        let FULLN = FN + " " + LN + extra

        // GY Airstrip
        pax.pickup = "" // Blank otherwise it persists between Loadsheets
        if (
          pax.pickupLocation &&
          pax.pickupLocation.locationName &&
          pax.pickupLocation.locationName.match(/Glenorchy Airstrip/gi)
        ) {
          pax.pickup = "GY"
        }
        if (
          pax.pickupLocation &&
          pax.pickupLocation.locationName &&
          pax.pickupLocation.locationName.match(/Blanket/gi)
        ) {
          pax.pickup = "GY"
        }
        if (pax.productCode && pax.productCode[2] && pax.productCode[2].match(/\-DR/gi)) {
          pax.pickup = "<span style='font-size:x-small'>DropGY</span>"
        }

        _paxList.push({
          bgColor: "white",
          firstName: FN,
          lastName: LN,
          fullName: FULLN,
          weight: w,
          product: pax.product,
          productCode: pax.productCode,
          pickupLocation: pax.pickupLocation,
          pickup: pax.pickup,
        })
      }

      //
      // Need the pilot and copilot to process first in the stack ******************************
      //
      if (data && data.length > 0 && typeof data[1] == "string") {
        if (a == 0) {
          _plane.pilot = data[1]
          _plane.crewWeight = data[0]
        }
        // Copilot
        if (a > 0) {
          if (typeof data[1] == "string") {
            let cp = "<span style='font-size:small'> (copilot: " + data[1] + ")</span>"
            _plane.copilot = data[1]
            _plane.copilot = cp
            _plane.crewWeight += data[0]
          } else {
            _plane.copilot = ""
          }
        }
      }

      /*










      Below are the functions that turn the data structure into CSS Classes for display














*/

      // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // Put objects into variables for display
      // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      $(".reg").css("background-color", _plane.regColor)
      $("._plane_pilot").html(_plane.pilot)
      //
      // Pilot Info (for FF)
      //
      //console.log("Matrix: %o", pilots.matrix)
      let pilotData = ""
      for (let a in pilots.matrix) {
        let p = pilots.matrix[a]
        let re = new RegExp(_plane.pilot, "ig")
        if (p[0] && p[0].match(re)) {
          pilotData = p
        }
      }
      if (pilotData && pilotData.length > 2) {
        $(".PIC_Phone").html(pilotData[2])
      }
      /*
          Burnoff : 75,
          LandingWeight : 1800,
          OutOfLimits : "",
          KGLBS:"KG",
          totalPaxWeight:166,
          totalFreightWeight:0,
          totalBagWeight:0
          */
    }
    // Display Pilot and Plane
    $("#pilot_name").html(WB.seats[0][1])

    //
    // Load _plane object into classes
    //
    for (let i in _plane) {
      $("._plane_" + i).html(_plane[i])
    }

    // Display Pax (Will need update for Caravan) ******************************************

    //
    // Clear out old values
    //
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
      $("._paxList-" + i + "-fullName").html("")
      $("._paxList-" + i + "-weight").html("")
      $("._paxList-" + i + "-product").html("")
      $("._paxList-" + i + "-pickup").html("")
    }
    // Flatten PaxList
    for (let i in _paxList) {
      for (let o in _paxList[i]) {
        $("._paxList-" + i + "-" + o).html(_paxList[i][o])
      }
    }
    // Flight Data V1 format:
    // date,time,pilot,plane,fuel,route,pax,paxWeights,pilotWeight,TOW,CG,numPax
    for (let px in _paxList) {
      let tis = _paxList[px].firstName + " " + _paxList[px].lastName
      let tat = _paxList[px].weight
      _trip.pax.push(tis)
      _trip.paxW.push(tat)
    }
    _trip.paxNames = _trip.pax.join(",")
    _trip.paxWeights = _trip.paxW.join(",")
    // Populate loadsheet data for printing
    _Loadsheet = {
      date: _trip.date,
      time: _trip.time,
      pilot: _plane.pilot,
      reg: _plane.reg,
      fuel: _plane.fuel,
      routes: _trip.routes,
      paxNames: _trip.paxNames,
      paxWeights: _trip.paxWeights,
      crewWeight: _plane.crewWeight,
      TOW: _plane.TOW,
      CG: _plane.CG,
      numPax: WB.numPax,
      copilot: _plane.copilot,
    }
    _loadsheetData = [
      _trip.date,
      _trip.time,
      _plane.pilot,
      _plane.reg,
      _plane.fuel,
      _trip.routes,
      _trip.paxNames,
      _trip.paxWeights,
      _plane.crewWeight,
      _plane.TOW,
      _plane.CG,
      WB.numPax,
    ]
    $("#details").hide()
    $("#planeDetails").hide()
    $("#Loadsheet").show()

    $("#FlightFollowing").hide()
    if (FF == true) {
      console.log("Seats: %o", WB.seats.length)
      $(".POB").html(WB.seats.length)
      $(".plane_Endurance_hour").html(_plane.Endurance.hour)
      $(".plane_Endurance_min").html(_plane.Endurance.min)
      $("#FlightFollowing").show()
    }
  }

  //var FF = true
  // some placeholder variables
  var _plane = {
    pilot: "[Pilot]",
    reg: "[REG]",
    type: "[GA8]",
    regColor: "white",
    fuel: "[75]", // Liters
    AEW: "",
    ZFW: "",
    fuelWeight: "[100]",
    MCTOW: 0,
    TOW: 0,
    Burnoff: "",
    LandingWeight: "",
    CGLimit: 0,
    CG: 0,
    OutOfLimits: "",
    crewWeight: 0,
    KGLBS: "[KG]",
    totalPaxWeight: 0,
    totalFreightWeight: "",
    totalBagWeight: "",
  }
  var _trip = {
    date: "1/12/2019",
    time: "08:00",
    route: "",
    pax: [],
    paxW: [],
  }
  var _paxList = []
  var _loadsheetData = []
</script>

<script>
  class Manifest {
    constructor(Board) {
      let _this = this
      this.board = Board
      this.$board = Board.$board // Keep a link to the board jQuery object
      this.json // Placeholder for Rezdy Parsed Data
      this.$bookings // Placeholder
      this.$this // Placeholder
      //this.$Bookings = this.$board.find(".Bookings") // get the root jQuery object to put all the Booking Divs into
    }
    getDate() {
      return this.board.$datepicker.datepicker("getDate")
    }
    write() {
      //
      // Manifest Div
      //
      let _this = this // _this instead of this because this is the calling button right now.

      this.$this = $(`<div class="Manifest_Container">
          <div id="Header" class="Header">
          <span class="total" style="float:left;display: inline-block;"></span>
          <span style="float:right;display: inline-block;"><button id="rr">(R)</button></span>
          <span style="float:right;display: inline-block;"><button id="reload">&#10226;</button></span>
          <span style="float:right;display: inline-block;"><button id="debug">&#937;</button></span>
          ${_this.board.$board.prop("id")} Manifest </div>
          <div id="Totals" />
          <div class="Bookings"></div>
          <div class="Roster" />
      </div>`)
      this.$board.append(this.$this)
      this.$bookings = this.$this.find(".Bookings")
      //
      // Manifest Reload Button
      //
      this.$this.find("#rr").click(function () {
        _this.loadRoster()
      })
      this.$this.find("#reload").click(function () {
        _this.load()
      })
      this.$this.find("#debug").click(function () {
        console.log(_this)
      })
    }
    loadRoster() {
      const $roster = this.$this.find(".Roster")
      $roster.empty()
      $roster.append("<div>Loading</div>")
      const d = this.getDate("getDate")
      const date = d.toString()
      google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(this.handleRosterLoad).withUserObject(this).loadRoster(date)
    }
    handleRosterLoad(args,manifest) {
    const $roster = manifest.$this.find(".Roster")
    $roster.empty()
    if (!!args) {
      let labels = args.values.map((row) => row[0])
      let results = args.values.map((row) => row[args.ci])
      let keyVal = args.values.map((row, ri) => {
        const key = row[0]
        const val = row[args.ci]
        const color = args.colors[ri][args.ci]
        return [key, val, color]
      })
      const rosterRows = keyVal.map(
        (row) => `<div><span style="background-color:${row[2]}">${row[0]} ${row[1]}</span></div>`
      )
      const $rosterContent = $("<div />")
      $rosterContent.append(rosterRows.join(""))
      $roster.append($rosterContent)
    }
  }
    // Call the Google Rezdy loading script, passing this object so the results can be returned into it
    load() {
      Rezdy.load(this)
    }
    onLoad(json) {
      console.log(`${this.board.$board.prop("id")} Manifest onLoad()`)
      this.data = JSON.parse(json) // parse json String data into a json object
      // to Rezdy, a "booking" is a "booking order" (cuz they couldn't decide which name they preferred)
      this.orders = this.data.bookings // [{Booking},{Booking},{Booking}] An array of booking objects
      this.$bookings.empty()
      this.show()
    }
    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    // Show Manifest
    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    show(date) {
      debug.log("Manifest.show()")
      debug.log("Requested Date:", date)
      console.log("JSON: (this.data) %o", this.data)
      if (!date) {
        date = this.getDate()
      }
      debug.log("Date used:", date, { Manifest })
      //
      // Filter by CONFIRMED
      //
      let orders = this.orders.filter((order) => order.status == "CONFIRMED")
      console.log("All Confirmed Orders Returned From Rezdy\n%o", orders) // [{Booking},{Booking},{Booking}]

      // ------------------
      // Tag each passenger
      // ------------------
      //
      // This pulls down the OrderNumber and Array numbers
      // so we can find the pax again in the Rezdy data structure from just the pax data
      //
      orders = orders.map((o) => {
        const orderNumber = o.orderNumber
        o.items = o.items.map((item, index) => {
          item.index = index
          item.participants = item.participants.map((pax, i) => {
            pax.fields.push({ label: "itemIndex", value: index })
            pax.fields.push({ label: "orderNumber", value: orderNumber })
            pax.fields.push({ label: "paxIndex", value: i })
            pax.fields.push({ label: "groupID", value: orderNumber + "_" + index })
            pax.fields.push({ label: "productCode", value: item.productCode })
            return pax
          })
          return item
        })
        return o
      })
      //
      // Filter by Date
      //
      let filteredManifest = this.filterByDate(orders, date)
      console.log("filteredManifest: %o", filteredManifest)
      //
      // Create Booking Objects
      //
      let bookings = []
      filteredManifest.forEach((order) => {
        order.items.forEach((item, i) => {
          bookings.push(new Booking(this, order, item, i))
        })
      })
      //
      // Sort Bookings by Start Time
      //
      bookings.sort((a, b) => (time.getHour(a.item.startTimeLocal) > time.getHour(b.item.startTimeLocal) ? 1 : -1))
      console.log("Sorted Bookings: %o", bookings)
      //
      // Totals
      //
      let dayParticipants = bookings.reduce((total, booking) => {
        return total + booking.item.participants.length
      }, 0)

      let dayPax = this.countPax(bookings)

      // -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // console.log("Month Total $%o", monthCost)
      this.$this.find("#Totals").text(
        "Manifest Pax(" + dayParticipants + ")(" + dayPax + ") "
        //"month(P" + monthParticipants + ")(X" + monthPax + ")"
      )
      // -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      //
      // Print Sprites
      //
      bookings.forEach((booking) => this.$bookings.append(booking.getSprite()))
      //
      // Update the board
      //
      this.board.update()
    }
    countPax(arr) {
      return arr.reduce((total, booking) => {
        let s1 = booking.item.participants.length
        let s2 = booking.item.quantities.reduce((total, q) => {
          let hasACI
          !!q.optionLabel.match(/^Adult/)
            ? (hasACI = true)
            : !!q.optionLabel.match(/^Child/)
            ? (hasACI = true)
            : !!q.optionLabel.match(/^Infant/)
            ? (hasACI = true)
            : (hasACI = false)
          if (hasACI) {
            return total + parseInt(q.value)
          }
          return total
        }, 0)
        let ret = s1
        if (s1 < s2) {
          ret = s2
        }
        return total + ret
      }, 0)
    }
    countTripCost(arr) {
      return arr.reduce((total, order) => {
        return total + parseInt(order.totalAmount)
      }, 0)
    }
    // ------------
    // filter
    // ------------
    filterByDate(orders, date) {
      let _date = date
      return orders
        .filter((element) =>
          element.items.some((subElement) => {
            return new Date(subElement.startTimeLocal).toDateString() == _date.toDateString()
          })
        )
        .map((element) => {
          let newElt = Object.assign({}, element) // copies element
          newElt.items = newElt.items.filter((subElement) => {
            return new Date(subElement.startTimeLocal).toDateString() == _date.toDateString()
          })
          return newElt
        })
    }
    filterByMonth(orders, date) {
      let month = date.getMonth()
      return orders
        .filter((element) =>
          element.items.some((subElement) => new Date(subElement.startTimeLocal).getMonth() == month)
        )
        .map((element) => {
          let newElt = Object.assign({}, element) // copies element
          newElt.items = newElt.items.filter((subElement) => new Date(subElement.startTimeLocal).getMonth() == month)
          return newElt
        })
    }
    // ------------
    // Get Orders
    // ------------
    //
    // Takes a list of booking numbers {GYA000881: "GYA000881", GYA000839: "GYA000839"}
    // And returns an array of Rezdy Orders (complete Order objects)
    //
    /*
      This will likely need some magic to handle split bookings ***********
    */
    getOrders(data) {
      //
      // returns an array of (rezdy) order objects
      //
      console.log("Manifest.getOrders() data: %o", data) // array of order numbers
      // [ Recursive ]
      // If it's a CellData object, re-run with just the CellData.orders[] array
      if (!!data && typeof data == "object" && !!data.orders) {
        return this.getOrders(data.orders)
      }
      //
      // return the matching order objects
      //
      let Orders = []
      if (!!data && Array.isArray(data)) {
        // Loop over the orders and return the matching manifest object
        for (let b in data) {
          let _oNum = data[b].split("_")[0]
          Orders.push(this.orders.find((x) => x.orderNumber === _oNum))
        }
        return Orders
      }
      return
    }
    getOrder(orderNumber, productNumber) {
      //
      // return the matching order objects
      //
      let data = this.data.bookings
      let Orders = []
      if (!!data && Array.isArray(data)) {
        // Loop over the orders and return the matching manifest object
        for (let b in data) {
          let _oNum = data[b].split("_")[0]
          Orders.push(this.orders.find((x) => x.orderNumber === _oNum))
        }
        return Orders
      }
      return
    }
    //
    // return total number of filled seats
    //
    getTotalPax() {
      let seats = 0
      $("#" + this.root.prop("id") + " .Manifest").each(function () {
        let json = $(this).data("json")
        for (let booking in json) {
          if (json[booking].orderNumber) {
            let book = json[booking].orderNumber.split("_")[0]
            if (json[booking].seats) {
              seats += json[booking].seats
            }
          }
        }
      })
      return seats
    }
  }
</script>

  // --------------------------------- Load Rezdy ----------------------------------------------
  function loadRezdy(requestedDate){

    if (!!requestedDate){
      requestedDate = requestedDate
    } else {
      requestedDate = Dates.getNZ($("#datepicker").datepicker('getDate'))
    }
    $(".Manifest_Container .Manifest").css("background-color","#ccc")
    google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(onRezdyLoad)
    .loadRezdy( requestedDate );
  }
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  //
  //----------------------------------- Receive Rezdy ( onRezdyLoad ) -----------------------------------------
  //
  // ---------------------------------- Show Manifest ---------------------------------------------------------
  //
  function onRezdyLoad(json) {
    utility.alert("Rezdy Loaded","#ManifestMessages")
    $(".Manifest_Container .Manifest").css("background-color","#68a167")
    // Remove all old booking objects (need to clear the board and theBoard array as well) ********************************
    $('.BookingSprite').remove()
    

    let data = JSON.parse(json)
    console.log( "JSON Loaded: %o",data )
    // -----------------------
    // Parse Rezdy Data
    //------------------------
    MANIFEST = rezdy.parseData(data)
    //
    // Sort bookings by trip time
    //
    MANIFEST.sort(function(a, b) {
      return a.time.localeCompare(b.time) // localCompare is a Javascript function
    })
    console.log("Manifest: %o",MANIFEST)
    $( "#MANIFEST" ).empty() // clear the old manifest list
    // ---------------------
    // Show Manifest
    // ---------------------
    display.showManifest(MANIFEST,style) // style is a global variable ("compact","verbose")
    
}

<script>

  function msgbox(text,buttontext,title) {
    buttontext = buttontext || "OK"
    title = title || ""
    $( "<div>" + text + "</div>" ).dialog({
      dialogClass: "no-close",
      title: title,
      position: { my: "left top", at: "left top", of: this },
      show: {
      effect: "blind", 
      duration: 300
      },
      buttons: [
        {
          text: buttontext,
          click: function() {
            window.top.close()           
            $( this ).dialog( "close" );
            $( this ).remove();
          }
        }
      ]
    });
  }

  class Pax {
    constructor(data) {
      if (!!data.fields) {
        this.fields = data.fields || ""
      } else {
        this.fields = data
      }
      this.seat = data.seat || null
      this.barcode = this.getValue("Barcode")
      this.orderNumber = this.getValue("orderNumber")
    }
    getValue(label){
      const rgxp = new RegExp(label, "i")
      const result = this.fields.find((x) => x.label.match(label))
      if (!!result){
        return result.value
      }
      return
    }
    getWeight() {
      //
      // Maybe a good place to add standard weights and standard weight addition (4kg)
      //
      let ret = this.fields.find((x) => x.label.match(/weight/i))
      // Always return KG...
      // Removes KG LBS etc
      ret = wb.getKilos(ret.value)

      return ret
    }
    getGroupColor() {
      Color.getByBooking()
    }
  }

          }
        }
      })
      if (data) {
        pilots.matrix = data
      }
    },

<script>
  // Object for TableCells
  class PlaneCell {
    constructor(board, r, c) {
      let _this = this // reference for inside the click function scope
      this._this = this // keep a reference to this JS object (self reference)
      this.board = board // reference to the instantiating board
      this.id = r + "_" + c
      this.row = r
      this.column = c
      // -------------------------------------------
      // jQuery object
      // -------------------------------------------
      let $this = $("<td />", {
        class: "PlaneCell Row_" + r + " Col_" + c,
        id: this.id,
      }).click(function () {
        _this.selectorPopup($(this))
      })
      $this.css({ position: "relative" })
      // -------------------------------------------
      // Backreference
      // -------------------------------------------
      $this.data("_script", this._this) // Backreference to JS from jQuery object
      this.$this = $this // keep a reference to the jQuery object
    }
    selectorPopup() {
      //
      console.log("PlaneCell Click")
      //
      const $this = this.$this
      const $drop = this.getDrop()
      $this.append($drop)
      $drop.css({ position: "absolute", top: "0px" })
      console.log("ID: %o", this.id)
      //
      const data = this.board.state.getData($this)
      console.log("PlaneCell data: %o", data)

      if (!data.loadsheet) {
        data.loadsheet = {
          type: "Plane",
          reg: "LOR",
          pilot: "James",
          fuel: 150,
        }
        this.saveData(data)
      }
    }
    //
    // Plane Dropmenu
    //
    getDrop() {
      /*
            This could be build a lot better... and generic (plane/pilot/etc)
      
      */
      const _this = this.$this
      let _drop = `<span class="dropdown">
        <button id="PlaneDrop" class="dropbtn">Plane</button>
        <div id="myPlaneDropdown" class="dropdown-content"></div></span>`

      let drop = $(`<div />`)
      drop.empty() // clear the old contents
      drop.append(_drop)
      $("#PlaneDrop").click(function () {
        for (let p in PlaneManager.planes.list) {
          let selected = PlaneManager.planes.list[p].reg

          let menu_row = "<div class='changePlane' id='" + selected + "'>" + selected + "</div>"
          drop.append(menu_row)
          /*
          
                selection action here **************************
          
          
          */
          $("#" + selected).click(function () {
            let PCF = _this.data("PCF")
            PCF[0] = selected

            drop.empty()
          })
        }
      })
      return drop
    }
    update() {
      const data = this._this.board.state.getData(this.$this)
      const PCF = data.loadsheet
      const $this = this.$this

      if (!!PCF) { // quick hack to avoid lack of defaults **********************
        const $content = $(`<div class="CellContent" />`)
        const $pilot = $(`<div class="pilot">${PCF.pilot}</div>`)
        const $plane = $(`<div class="plane">${PCF.reg}</div>`)
        const $fuel = $(`<div class="fuel">${PCF.fuel}</div>`)
        $content.append($plane).append($pilot).append($fuel)

        $this.empty()
        $this.append($content)
      }
    }
    getData() {
      return this.board.state.getData(this.$this) // get the CellData Object from the state object
    }
    saveData(data) {
      this.board.state.addData(this.$this, data)
    }
    setPlaneData(key, val) {
      console.log("Set Plane Data, Key: %o Val: %o", key, val)
      let s = this.getState() // get copy of current State
      let state = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(s))
      state.loadsheet[key] = val
      console.log("Set State: %o", state)
      this.setState(state)
    }
    getState() {
      return (state = this.board.state.getData(this.$this)) // get the CellData Object from the state object
    }
  }
</script>

  var planes = {
    rawData: [],
    data: [],
    getPlane: function (registration) {
      for (let r in this.data) {
        if (this.data[r].reg == registration) {
          return this.data[r]
        }
      }
      return null
    },
  }
  root.planes = planes
  var PlaneManager = {
    planes: planes, // quick cheat to externalize planes object to root {planes}
    //
    // Load in plane hours from spreadsheet
    //
    loadHours: function () {
      google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(this.onPlaneDataLoad).loadPlaneData()
    },
    onPlaneDataLoad: function (data) {
      let planes = {}
      for (let a in data[0]) {
        planes[data[0][a]] = data[0][a]
      }
      for (let row in data) {
        for (let col in data[row]) {
          if (data[row][col]) {
            planes[data[0][col]] = data[row][col]
          }
        }
      }
      $(".PlaneCell").each(function () {
        $("> #hours", this).remove() // removes all "hours" children
        let PCF = $(this).data("PCF")
        let id = PCF[0]

        let hours = planes[id]

        let span = "<div id='hours' style='font-size:small;'>[hrs: <B>" + hours + "</B>]</div>"
        $(this).prepend(span)
      })
    },

    loadPlanes: function (data) {
      //
      // Parse loaded two dimensional array into root planes object
      //
      //
      // Because this gets called from a Success Handler (Google), "this" is the Window Object, so we'll make our own "_this"
      //
      let _this = PlaneManager
      let _rawData = planes.rawData // Everything loaded from the spreadsheet
      let _planeData = planes.data // Excludes non-plane data like "NoJTK"
      //
      // Convert [[]] to [{}]
      // Objects key'd by header row labels (lowercased) *** maybe clean more than just lowercasing ***
      //
      data.forEach((row, i) => {
        let rowPlane = {}
        if (i > 0) {
          row.forEach((element, pos) => {
            rowPlane[data[0][pos].toLowerCase()] = element // use header row element as variable name for element value
          })
          _rawData.push(rowPlane)
        }
      })
      // ----------------------------
      // Filter out extraneous planes
      // ----------------------------
      //
      // Convert [{}] object list to [{Class}] Classed objects based on "type" attribute (206/208/GA8)
      //
      _rawData.forEach((plane) => {
        if (!!plane.type && !plane.legacy) {
          let dynamic_class = eval(plane.type)
          let instance = new dynamic_class(plane)
          _planeData.push(instance)
        }
      })
    },
    planePopup: function (_this) {
      let container = $("#planeDetails")
      //
      let PCF = _this.data("PCF")
      this.dropmenu(_this)
      //
      container.show()
    },
    //
    // Drop Menu
    //
    dropmenu: function (_this) {
      this.dropPlane(_this)
      this.dropPilot(_this)
      this.dropCoPilot(_this)
      this.dropFuel(_this)
    },

<script>
  // Close the dropdown if the user clicks outside of it
  window.onclick = function (event) {
    if (!event.target.matches(".dropbtn")) {
      let dropdowns = document.getElementsByClassName("dropdown-content")
      let i
      for (i = 0; i < dropdowns.length; i++) {
        let openDropdown = dropdowns[i]
        if (openDropdown.classList.contains("show")) {
          openDropdown.classList.remove("show")
        }
      }
    }
  }
</script>

<script>
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // This is an object to hold functions to communicate with remote servers (Google)
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  var Rezdy = {
    // --------------------------------- Load Rezdy ----------------------------------------------
    /*

    We're just checking to see if a date was passed in, and if not, check the date picker.
    Since we're going to have multiple date pickers, we'll want to do something like pass in the "board" object and just interragate it's datepicker.
    Then we can update that board with the return data.

    */
    load: function (Manifest) {
      console.log("Rezdy.load({Manifest})")
      //
      // Date Check (should be a Manifest object)
      //
      let requestedDate
      if (typeof Manifest == "object") {
        requestedDate = Manifest.getDate() // returns a {date} object
      } else {
        console.log("Rezdy.load: Wrong object")
        return
      }
      requestedDate.setDate(requestedDate.getDate() - 1)
      requestedDate.setHours(3, 0, 0, 0)
      debug.log("requestedDate:", requestedDate , {Rezdy})
      //
      // Call the google script and pass it the Manifest
      //
      let startDate = new Date(requestedDate)
      startDate = startDate.toString()

      debug.log("startDate:", startDate)

      let endDate = new Date(requestedDate)
      endDate.setDate(endDate.getDate() + 1)
      endDate = endDate.toString()

      debug.log("endDate:", endDate)

      $(".Manifest_Container .Manifest").css("background-color", "#ccc")
      google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(this.onLoad).withUserObject(Manifest).loadRezdy(startDate, endDate)
    },
    // Passes Google Script XML return back to the Manifest that called the script
    onLoad: function (ret, Manifest) {
      debug.log("Rezdy.onLoad()")
      debug.log("Requested URL:", ret.url)
      console.log(`Manifest: ${Manifest.board.$board.prop("id")}`)
      Manifest.onLoad(ret.json)
    },
    onTripCodeLoad: function (data) {
      debug.log("OnTripCodeLoad: %o", data)
      gya.trips = data
      return data
    },
    loadTripCodes: function () {
      google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(Rezdy.onTripCodeLoad).loadTripCodes()
    },
    // ========================================== Parse Rezdy Data ==========================================

    //
    // Takes a JSON object of data and returns a list of Booking objects
    //
    parseData: function (data) {
      let bookings = {}
      //
      for (let a in data.bookings) {
        let order = data.bookings[a]
        // if there's no orderNumber, skip it
        if (!order.orderNumber) {
          continue
        }
        for (let i in order.items) {
          let key = order.orderNumber
          if (i > 0) {
            key = key + "-" + i
          }
          bookings[key] = new Booking(order, i, key)
        }
      }
      return bookings
    },
  }
</script>
function clearRezdy() {
  var sheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet()
    .getSheetByName("Rezdy")
    .getRange(getProperty("assignmentBoard"))
    .setHorizontalAlignment("left")
    .setBackground("WHITE")
    .setValue("")
}
// =======================================================
//         Add Months to date (utility)
// =======================================================
function add_months(dt, n) {
  dt.setHours(09)
  return new Date(dt.setMonth(dt.getMonth() + n))
}
// =======================================================
//         Load TripCodes
// =======================================================
function loadTripCodes() {
  var data = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().getSheetByName("TripCodes").getRange("A:I").getValues()
  return data
}
// =======================================================
//         Load Rezdy
// =======================================================
//
// Accepts one or two date objects in String format... {date}.toString()
// Returns an object of data values (including the requested dates/etc)
//
function loadRezdy(startDate,endDate) {
  Logger.log("Rezdy_GS.loadRezdy()")
  Logger.log("startDate " + startDate)
  Logger.log("endDate " + endDate)

  // Process date arguments ... default to just today if no endDate
  var date1 = new Date(startDate)
  var date2 = new Date(startDate)
  date2.setDate(date2.getDate() + 1) // next Day
  !!endDate ? date2 = new Date(endDate) : null // if an end date is passed in, use it instead
  date1 = Utilities.formatDate(date1, Session.getScriptTimeZone(), "yyyy-MM-dd") // Google Utilities Object
  date2 = Utilities.formatDate(date2, Session.getScriptTimeZone(), "yyyy-MM-dd")

  var orderLinkPrefix = "https://app.rezdy.com/orders/edit/"

  var ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet()
  var sheet = ss.getSheetByName("Rezdy")
  var range = sheet.getRange(getProperty("assignmentBoard"))
  var values = range.getValues()

  range.setValue("")

  // ****************************************
  // Abstract all this away somewhere generic
  // ****************************************
  var rez = "https://api.rezdy.com/v1/bookings"
  var apiKey = "?apiKey=4a02ae91ede241fd80324ec8b2ac57cb"
  var call = "&minTourStartTime=" + date1 + "T02:00:00Z&maxTourStartTime=" + date2 + "T08:00:00Z" 
  // T14:00:00Z Use 2am to avoid Daylight Savings Time issues
  // BoardV1 version https://api.rezdy.com/v1/bookings?apiKey=4a02ae91ede241fd80324ec8b2ac57cb&minTourStartTime=2020-09-06T12:00:00Z&maxTourStartTime=2020-09-08T09:00:00Z

  // Call the Numbers API for random math fact
  var url = rez + apiKey + call
  Logger.log("API Call:")
  Logger.log(rez + apiKey + call) // ========= Useful for debugging ============

  var response = UrlFetchApp.fetch(url)
  //Logger.log(response.getContentText()) // ========= Useful for debugging ============

  // Make request to API and get response before this point.
  var json = response.getContentText()
  //DriveApp.createFile('test.json', json);  // ================= Write JSON to file =============================

  var ret = {}
    ret.startTime = date1
    ret.endTime = date2
    ret.json = json
    ret.url = url
  return ret
}

    getData($cell) {

      typeof $cell == "string" ? (id = $cell) : (id = $cell.prop("id"))
      let data = this.data[id]
      if (!data) {
        data = new CellData(id)
      }
      return data

<script>
  // Object for TableCells
  class TableCell extends Plottable {
    constructor(board, r, c) {
      super()
      let _this = this // reference for inside the click function scope
      this._this = this // keep a reference to this JS object (self reference)
      this.board = board // reference to the instantiating board
      this.id = r + "_" + c
      this.planeCellID = "0_" + c
      this.$PlaneCell = $("#0_" + c)
      this.row = r
      this.column = c
      this.hour // Placeholder
      this.leg
      //
      // _this.getData() holds all the Cell's data
      //
      // -------------------------------------------
      // jQuery object
      // -------------------------------------------
      let $this = $("<td />", {
        class: "TableCell Row_" + r + " Col_" + c,
        id: this.id,
      })
      // -------------------------------------------
      // Backreference
      // -------------------------------------------
      $this.data("_script", this._this) // Backreference to JS from jQuery object
      this.$this = $this // keep a reference to the jQuery object
      // -------------------------------------------
      // Droppable
      // -------------------------------------------
      $this.droppable({
        accept: ".BookingSprite, .TableCell",
        drop: this.handleDrop,
        delay: 100, // Might not need this now *******************
      })
      // -------------------------------------------
      // Click
      // -------------------------------------------
      $this.click(function () {
        console.log("TableCell Click, %o", _this)
        _this.show()
        //
        let data = _this.getData()
        console.log("Data: %o", data)
        if (!!data) {
          // ****************************
          // Either pass in the wb data to Details, or have Details reach back and call the function
          //
          _this.getLoadedAirplane()
          $("#Details").data("root").show($(this))
          $("#Details").show()
        }
      })
    }
    // -------------------------------------------
    // Drop
    // -------------------------------------------
    handleDrop(event, ui) {
      //
      // Since this is getting called externally, "this" isn't this obj
      // So we'll use the jQuery $(this) to get a pointer to this object
      //
      let $dropped = ui.draggable // ui.draggable : The Manifest Sprite or $dropped TableCell
      let _dropped = $dropped.data("_script") // ({TableCell} or {Booking}) JS object attached to the Selector
      //_dropped.constructor.name // {TableCell} or {Booking}
      let _this = $(this).data("_script") // This JS Object
      let cellData = _this.getData()

      let leg = _this.getLeg()
      let droppedIsOut = _dropped.isOut()

      if (_this.isLegalDrop(leg, droppedIsOut)) {
        // ------------
        // Record Drop
        // ------------

        /*
        - Merge Dropped Pax -
        cellData.passengers 
        _dropped.getPassengers()
        [{fields: Array(9)}]

        Merging with Set() removes duplicates
        */
        cellData.passengers = [...new Set([...cellData.passengers, ..._dropped.getPassengers()])]

        //
        // Brand the cell
        //
        !!cellData.leg ? null : (cellData.leg = _dropped.getLeg())
        //
        _this.board.state.data[this.id] = cellData // record the new data
        //
        // Make Draggable
        //
        $(this).draggable("enable")
        //
        // Centers the cursor
        //
        $(this).draggable("option", "cursorAt", {
          left: Math.floor(ui.helper.width() / 2),
          top: Math.floor(ui.helper.height() / 2),
        })
        _this.removeBookings(ui, _this)
        //
        // === Update ===
        //
        _this.board.update() // board.update() calls update() on each TableCell.
        // *** possibly only update effected cells ************************************

        $dropped.css("background-color", "var(--main-bg-color)") // Color the manifest object
      } else {
        let msg = "Wrong Type: DroppedIsOut" + droppedIsOut + " CellLeg: " + leg
        utility.error(msg)
      }
    }
    addPax(pax) {}
    removeBookings(ui, _this) {
      $(ui.helper).remove()
      let $dropped = ui.draggable // ui.draggable : The Manifest Sprite or $dropped TableCell
      let _dropped = $dropped.data("_script")
      if (!!_dropped.board) {
        _dropped.board.state.removeOrder($dropped) // List of bookings instead?**************
        _dropped.update()
      }
    }
    clear() {
      this.$this.removeClass("inCell")
      this.$this.removeClass("outCell")
      this.update()
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
    // isLegalDrop
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
    isLegalDrop(cellLeg, droppedIsOut) {
      let cellIsOut = cellLeg == "B"
      /*
      Cell hasn't been branded = legal // can be either
      Cell matches drop = legal

      ***************************************************************************
      Probably need to add further looking tests for return flight cell checks...
      Or, those checks can call this function
      ***************************************************************************
      */
      console.log("isLegalDrop(cellIsOut, droppedIsOut) %o %o", cellIsOut, droppedIsOut)
      let legal
      cellLeg == null ? (legal = true) : cellIsOut == droppedIsOut ? (legal = true) : (legal = false)
      return legal
    }
    // ------------------------------
    // getBookingObjects
    // ------------------------------
    //
    // Check the State and get the CellData objects
    // pass them to the Manifest and get back the actual booking order objects
    //
    getOrders() {
      //
      // Returns an array of booking objects objects (from State)
      //
      let manifest = this.board.manifest
      let data = this.getData()
      let retArray = data.bookingOrders.map((o) => {
        if (!o) {
          return
        }
        let s = o.split("_") // orderNumber + "_" + productCode + "_" + itemNumber
        let orderNumber = s[0]
        let itemNumber = parseInt(s[2])
        let order = manifest.orders.find((x) => x.orderNumber === orderNumber)
        if (!!order) {
          let item = order.items[itemNumber]
          if (!!item) {
            let booking = new Booking(manifest, order, item, itemNumber)
            return booking
          }
        }
      })
      if (!retArray[0]) {
        retArray.shift()
      }
      return retArray
    }
    getData() {
      //
      // get the CellData Object from the state object
      //
      return this.board.state.getData(this.$this) // get the CellData Object from the state object
    }
    setPlaneData(key, val) {
      console.log("Set Plane Data, Key: %o Val: %o", key, val)
      let s = this.getState() // get copy of current State
      let state = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(s))
      state.loadsheet[key] = val
      console.log("Set State: %o", state)
      this.setState(state)
    }
    setState(state) {
      this.board.state.data[state.cellID] = state
    }
    getState() {
      let state = this.board.state.getData(this.$this) // get the CellData Object from the state object
      // Check for an assigned plane. If none, get from the PlaneCell
      if (!!state.loadsheet && !!state.loadsheet.reg) {
        return state
      }
      let PCState = this.$PlaneCell.data("_script").getData()
      let data = {
        loadsheet: PCState.loadsheet,
      }
      state = { ...state, ...data }
      return state
    }
    getLeg() {
      if (!!this.getData()) {
        return this.getData().leg
      }
      return null
    }
    getPlane() {
      let state = this.getState()
      //
      // Get the airplane raw data
      //
      let loadsheet = PlaneManager.planes.data.find(function (el) {
        return el.reg == state.loadsheet.reg
      })
      //
      // convert to Airplane Object
      //
      let airplane
      if (!!loadsheet.type) {
        let dynamic_class = eval(loadsheet.type)
        airplane = new dynamic_class(loadsheet)
      }

      let fuelStation = airplane.stations.find((station) => station.type.includes("fuel"))
      fuelStation.weight = parseInt(state.loadsheet.fuel) * 0.72 // Adjust for Jet A ********** (.8) ****

      return airplane
    }
    getSeats() {
      const _wb = this.getLoadedAirplane()
      let seats = _wb.stations.filter((station) => {
        return station.type.includes("seat") && parseInt(station.weight) > 0
      })
      return seats
    }
    getLoadedAirplane() {
      // if seats aren't assigned, sort by crew, then weight
      // if seats are assigned, check that they fit the plane, then use them.

      // Reg
      // Fuel
      // Pilot
      // CoPilot

      // Pax
      // Luggage
      // Modifications (seats/controls/pods)
      // Baggage
      let airplane = this.getPlane()
      /* ********************************************************************************************
        airplane
        .station ... stations will include the pilot and copilot... we'll hardcode them for now *****
        *********************************************************************************************
      */
      airplane.stations[0].weight = 83 // hardcoding pilot weight for now *******************
      airplane.stations[0].pax = [
        { label: "Role", value: "PIC" },
        { label: "First Name", value: "Zapp" },
        { label: "Last Name", value: "Brannigan" },
        { label: "Full Name", value: "Zapp Brannigan" },
        { label: "Weight", value: 79 },
      ]
      airplane.stations[1].weight = 46 // hardcoding pilot weight for now *******************
      airplane.stations[1].pax = [
        { label: "Role", value: "SIC" },
        { label: "First Name", value: "Kif" },
        { label: "Last Name", value: "Kroker" },
        { label: "Full Name", value: "Kif Kroker" },
        { label: "Weight", value: 42 },
      ]
      $(".station")
        .children()
        .each(function (i, $div) {
          let seat
          let weight
          let pax // array of Rezdy labels [{},{}]
          seat = parseInt($(this).closest(".station").data("seat")) - 1 // 0 based counting
          pax = $(this).data("pax")
          weight = $(this).data("_pax").getWeight()
          if (seat >= 0) {
            airplane.stations[seat].weight = weight
            airplane.stations[seat].pax = pax
          }
        })
      return airplane
    }
    // Perhaps "hasOuts()" ************************************
    // This only tells you if the cell contains outs, not the direction of the leg
    isOut() {
      return this.getOrders().some((x) => x.isOut() == true)
    }
    getTime() {
      // Maybe make the row's time a class? **************************************
    }
    //
    // get Plane Crew Fuel
    //
    getPCF() {
      return this.getState()
    }
    getHour() {}
    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Update
    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    update() {
      let cellData = this.getState() // Get the data from the state object
      let $this = this.$this // simplify the reference to the jQuery object
      // --------------
      // Make Draggable
      // --------------
      // Turn draggable on by default, then off if not needed... otherwise you have to test for it's existence before truning it off.
      /*
        (Example)
        Uncaught Error: cannot call methods on draggable prior to initialization;
        attempted to call method 'disable'
      */
      $this.draggable({
        revert: true,
        helper: "clone",
      })
      // --------------
      // Blank the cell
      // --------------
      $this.text("")
      $this.css("background-image", "")
      $this.removeClass("outCell")
      $this.removeClass("inCell")
      // --------
      // If Data
      // --------
      if (!!cellData && cellData.passengers.length > 0) {
        //
        // In/Out Chevrons
        //
        switch (this.getLeg()) {
          case "A":
          case null:
            let name = "--in"
            let val = "pink"
            CSS.setVal(name, val)
            //
            // In
            //
            $this.removeClass("outCell")
            $this.addClass("inCell")
            break
          case "B":
            //
            // Out
            //
            $this.removeClass("inCell")
            $this.addClass("outCell")
            break
        }

        let codes = []
        for (const a in cellData.passengers) {
          const pax = cellData.passengers[a].fields
          const pc = pax.find((item) => item.label === "productCode").value
          codes = [...new Set([...codes, ...[pc]])]
        }
        const GYACodes = codes.map((c) => gya.getProduct(c).GYACode)
        const numPax = cellData.passengers.length
        //const codes = "TMP"
        $this.html(`(${numPax})  ${GYACodes.join("<BR>")}`)
        $this.draggable({
          //revert: true,
          helper: "clone",
          cursorAt: { left: 5, top: 5 },
        })
      } else {
        $this.draggable("disable")
      }
    }
  }
</script>

  class Names {
    constructor(names) {
      this.names = names
    }
    contains(names) {
      return names.every((name) => this.names.indexOf(name) !== -1)
    }
  }

  function test3(_row) {
    console.log("showpickups")

    let pickupList = $("#PickupList")
    let row = _row.prop("id")

    let totalPickup = 0
    let totalPax = 0
    $("#PickupContents").remove()
    pickupList.append("<div id='PickupContents'></div>")
    //$("#PickupContents").append("<div id='TripManifest' class='TripManifest'></div")
    $("#PickupContents").append("<div id='PickupManifest' class='PickupManifest'></div>")

    $("." + row).each(function () {
      let JSON = $(this).data("json")
      if (!jQuery.isEmptyObject(JSON)) {
        for (let b in JSON) {
          let seats = JSON[b].seats
          let pickup = true
          let pickupLocation = ""
          if (JSON[b].pickupLocation) {
            if (JSON[b].pickupLocation.locationName) {
              pickupLocation = JSON[b].pickupLocation.locationName
              if (pickupLocation.match(/self drive/gi)) {
                pickup = false
              }
              if (pickupLocation.match(/Glenorchy Airstrip/gi)) {
                pickup = false
              }
            }
          }
          let _seats = JSON[b].pax.length
          totalPax += _seats
          if (pickup) {
            if (!pickupLocation) {
              pickupLocation = "Unspecified"
            }
            if (JSON[b].product && JSON[b].product.match(/out/gi)) {
              pickupLocation = "Outs"
            }
            $("#PickupManifest").append("<B>" + _seats + "</B> " + pickupLocation + "<br>")
            totalPickup += _seats
          }
        }
        //
        // Trip Manifest
        //
        let PlaneDetails = $("#TripManifest")
        let _plane

        PlaneDetails.append("<div></div>")
        //
        // Each Booking
        //
        for (let b in JSON) {
          let _booking = JSON[b]
          let _seats = JSON[b].pax.length

          if (b == 0 && JSON[b].IN) {
            let col = theBoard.getColumn(JSON[b].IN)
            if (col) {
              _plane = $("#ac" + col)
            }
            let _reg = ""
            if (_plane.data("PCF")) {
              _reg = _plane.data("PCF")[0]
            }
            PlaneDetails.append(" " + _reg + " ")
          }

          PlaneDetails.append(_seats)
          PlaneDetails.append(" " + _booking.product + " ")

          let extras = "<span style='font-size:small'>"
          if (_booking.extras.length > 0) {
            for (let e in _booking.extras) {
              if (_booking.extras[e].name) {
                // **************************** Could be turned into an array and pushed *****************************
                let _quantity = _booking.extras[e].quantity
                let _ex = _booking.extras[e].name.split("(")[0]
                extras += "<span style='font-size:x-small'>(" + _quantity + ")</span>" + _ex + " "
              }
            }
          }
          extras = extras + "</span>"

          PlaneDetails.append(" " + extras + " ")
        }
      }
    })
    if (totalPickup > 0) {
      $("#PickupManifest").prepend("Pickup Manifest.<BR>Total Pax: " + totalPickup + "<P>")
      $("#TripManifest").prepend("Flight Manifest.<BR>Total Pax: " + totalPax + "<P>")

      $("#PickupContents").prepend("<br>")
      //$("#PickupContents").prepend("<B>" + $(this).html() + "</B><br>") // ** What's $(this).html() ?
      $("#PickupContents").append(
        "<span style='float:right; width: 100%; display: block; position: absolute; top: 0;' onClick='utility.printPickup()' >Print</span>"
      )
    } else {
      $("#PickupContents").prepend("<B>No Pickups/Dropoffs Required for this time<P>")
    }
    pickupList.show()
  }

  timeStamp:{
    value:null,
    compare:function(remoteValue){
      let localValue = theBoard.timeStamp.value

      let match = false
      let msg = ""
      if (localValue == remoteValue){
        msg = "match"
        match = true
      } else {
        msg = "no match"
      }
      
      if (match){
        $("#SaveButton").css({"background": "green",})
        setTimeout(function(){ $("#SaveButton").css({"background": "blue",}) }, 2000)
      } else {
        $("#SaveButton").css({"background": "red",})
        setTimeout(function(){ $("#SaveButton").css({"background": "blue",}) }, 2000)
      }
      utility.alert(msg)
    },
    saveRemote:function(date){
      // This is already saved with each save to the board data
    },
    saveLocal:function(TimeStamp){
      let d = new Date(TimeStamp)
      let date = Dates.getNZ(d)
      utility.alert(date)
      theBoard.timeStamp.value = TimeStamp
    },
    checkRemote:function(){
      google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(theBoard.timeStamp.compare).getLastSave()
    },
    getRemote:function(){
     // google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(theBoard.timeStamp.compare).getLastSave()

      google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(theBoard.timeStamp.saveLocal).getLastSave()

  getManifest: function(row){
    //
    // Get the row's manifest. If no row is passed in, return a full day manifest
    //
      let manifest = {
        trip:{
          time:  null,
        },
        pax:{
          total:0,
          bookings:[],
        },
        onGround:{
          // List of product codes that we're tracking people on the ground .. needs a better system ***********
          products:[
            "PR115C",
            "P03UKW",
            "PX31V0",
            "PYML6Y",
            "P3BW7J",
            "PWHCSM"
          ],
          Milford:[],
          MtCook:[],
          bootsOnGround: function(code){
            for (let c in manifest.onGround.products){
              if (manifest.onGround.products[c] == code){
                return true
              }
            }
            return false
          },
        },
        pickups:{
          total:0,
          stops:[],
        },
        nonPickups:{
          SelfDrive:[],
          GlenorchyAirstrip:[],
        },
      }
    if(!!row){
      //
      manifest.trip.time = $(".TimeCell."+row).text()
      //
      // Each column in the row
      //
      $("."+row).each(function(){
            let JSON = $(this).data('json')
            if ( !jQuery.isEmptyObject(JSON) ){
              //
              // Each booking in the column
              //
              for(let b in JSON){
                let booking = JSON[b]
                let pickup = true
                let pickupLocation = ""
                //
                if (booking.pickupLocation){
                  if (booking.pickupLocation.locationName){
                    pickupLocation = booking.pickupLocation.locationName
                    //
                    if (booking.product && booking.product.match(/out/ig)){
                      pickupLocation = "Outs"
                    }
                    if(pickupLocation.match(/self drive/ig)){
                      manifest.nonPickups["SelfDrive"].push(booking)
                      pickup = false
                    }
                    else if(pickupLocation.match(/Glenorchy Airstrip/ig)){
                      manifest.nonPickups["GlenorchyAirstrip"].push(booking)
                      pickup = false
                    }
                  }
                  else {
                    pickupLocation = "Unspecified"
                  }
                  if (pickup){
                    manifest.pickups.stops.push(booking)
                    manifest.pickups.total += booking.pax.length
                  }
                  //
                  // Boots on ground
                  //
                  let code = booking.productCode[1]
                  if (manifest.onGround.bootsOnGround(code)){
                    manifest.onGround.Milford.push(booking)
                  }
                  //
                  // totals
                  //
                  manifest.pax.total += booking.pax.length
                  manifest.pax.bookings.push(booking)
                }
              }
            }
        }
      )
      return manifest
    } else {
      console.log("No Row, return full manifest")
      let ret = []
      $(".PickupCell").each(function(){
        let _o = theBoard.getManifest($(this).prop('id'))
        ret.push(_o)
      })
      return ret
    }

  save: function(){
    $("#SaveButton").css({"background": "green",})
    setTimeout(function(){ $("#SaveButton").css({"background": "blue",}) }, 2000)
    let data = {}
    //
    // Loop over all the table cells
    //
    $(".TableCell").each(function(index) {
        let json = $(this).data('json')
        if (typeof json != "undefined" && !jQuery.isEmptyObject(json)) {
             for (let j in json){
               for (let key in json[j]){
                 if (key == "pickupLocation"){
                   if (json[j][key].pickupInstructions){
                     delete json[j][key].pickupInstructions
                   }
                   if (json[j][key].address){
                     delete json[j][key].address
                   }
                 }
                 if(key == "internalNotes"){
                   delete json[j][key]
                 }
                 if(key == "pickupInstructions"){
                   delete json[j][key]
                 }
                 if(key == "pax"){
                   for (let p in json[j][key]){
                     let pax = json[j][key][p]
                     if (pax.pickupLocation && pax.pickupLocation.address){
                       delete pax.pickupLocation.address
                     }
                     if (pax.pickupLocation && pax.pickupLocation.pickupInstructions){
                       delete pax.pickupLocation.pickupInstructions
                     }
                   }
                 }
               }
             }
            // push each booking into data hash
            if (!jQuery.isEmptyObject(json)){
              data[$(this).attr("id")] = json
            }
        }
    });
    $(".PlaneCell").each(function(index) {
        let json = $(this).data('PCF')
        if (typeof json != "undefined" && !jQuery.isEmptyObject(json)) {
            // push each booking into data hash
            if (!jQuery.isEmptyObject(json)){
              data[$(this).attr("id")] = json
            }
        }
    });
    //
    // Save
    //
    let dataArry = []
    
    let s1 = {}
    let s2 = {}
    let s3 = {}
    let s4 = {}
    let count = 0
    for (let a in data){
      if (count<10){
        s1[a] = data[a]
        count++
      } else {
        if (count<15){
          s2[a] = data[a]
                  count++
        } else {
          if (count<20){
            s3[a] = data[a]
                    count++
          } else {
            s4[a] = data[a]
                    count++
          }
        }
      }
    }
    let date = Dates.getNZ($("#datepicker").datepicker('getDate'))
    //
    // Split data up so as not to overload Google's 50K cell limit ***************** 
    //
    dataArry.push(date)
    dataArry.push(JSON.stringify(s1))
    dataArry.push(JSON.stringify(s2))
    dataArry.push(JSON.stringify(s3))
    dataArry.push(JSON.stringify(s4))
    google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(theBoard.timeStamp.saveLocal).saveBoard( dataArry )

  getRow:function(_this,getClass){
    let classes = _this.prop("classList")
    let row
    let rowClass
    for(let c in classes){
      let isString = (typeof classes[c] == 'string') ? true:false
      if (isString){
          let r = classes[c].match(/Row_\d.*/)
          if(!!r&&!!r[0]){
            rowClass = r[0]
            row = r[0].split("_")[1]
            break // Because Classes also list all the classes as a single string... which will match()
        }
      }
    }
    if(getClass){row=rowClass}
    return row
  },

    }
    return col

  highlightFerryLegs:function(){

    //
    // Clear old Ferry Leg text
    //
    $(".TableCell").each(function() {
      if ($(this).html().match(/ferry/ig)){
        $(this).html("")
      }
    })
    // Each Row in Each Column (use PlaneCell array to loop over columns)
    //
    // Each Column
    //
    $(".PlaneCell").each(function(_col) {
    //
    // Each Row
    //
      $(".Col_"+_col).each(function(_row){
        if( _row == 0) {
          last = "out" // Reset the top of every Column to "out" by default (so it always assumes the plane starts in QT)
        }
        let _type = $(this).data("type")
        if (_type){
          if (_type == "in" && last == "in"){
              let ferryRowNum = _row -2
              let ferryRow = $("#" + ferryRowNum + _col)
              
              if ( ferryRow.data("type") == null ){
                ferryRow.html("<span style='color:#c9735d;'>Ferry Out</span>")
              }
              
          }
          if (_type == "out" && last != "in"){
              let ferryRowNum = _row -2
              let ferryRow = $("#" + ferryRowNum + _col)
              
              if ( ferryRow.data("type") == null ){
                ferryRow.html("<span style='color:#c9735d;'>Ferry In</span>")
              }
            }
          last = _type
        }
      })
    })
  }
