  var time = {
    //
    // We can make getTime pseudo-polymorphic by examining what's passed in and replying accordingly.
    // So if we pass in a in12hr boolean, we give it back in AM/PM
    //
    getTime: function (string, in12hr) {
      let date = new Date(string)
      let hours = date.getHours()
      let minutes = date.getMinutes()
      if (minutes == 0) {
        minutes = "00"
      }
      return hours + ":" + minutes
    },
    getHour: function (string) {
      //time: "2019-10-03 15:15:00"
      let date = new Date(string)
      let hour = date.getHours()
      if (hour > 12) {
        hour = hour - 12
      }
      if (hour > 6 && hour < 10) {
        hour = "" + 0 + hour
      }
      hour = hour + ":00"
      return hour
    },
    getHourByRow: function (row, numDigits) {
      let hour = row + 7 // Assumes row 0 is a header row and the day starts at 8am
      if (hour > 12) {
        hour = hour - 12
      }
      if (!!numDigits && numDigits > 1 && hour < 10) {
        hour = "0" + "" + hour
      }
      return hour
    },
    getRowByHour(hour) {
      return this.getRow(hour)
    },
    getRow: function (h) {
      let hour = parseInt(h)
      if (hour > 12) {
        hour = hour - 12
      }
      // Array of all TimeCells
      let all = $(".TimeCell")
        .map(function () {
          return this.id
        })
        .get()
      // Match Time to Timecell

      if (hour > 0) {
        for (id in all) {
          let row = $("#" + all[id])
          let rHour = parseInt(row.data("hour"))
          if (hour == rHour) {
            return row
          }
        }
      }

      return null
    },
  }

// -------------------------
// 24hr to 12hr

function time12 (time) {
  time = time.split(':')
  let hour = parseInt(time[0],10)
  let PM = hour>12 ? true : false
  if (PM) {
    hour = hour - 12
  }
  return hour + ':' + time[1]

  var utility = {
    // ========================================== Get Pax ==========================================
    // Takes JSON booking
    // Returns pax object
    //    adult: ret[0],
    //    child: ret[1],
    //    infant: ret[2],
    //    seats: seats,
    //    code: code,
    //    ACI: ACI,

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Get passenger numbers. If quantities are by product and not pax, return false
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    getPax: function (json) {
      let byPax = false
      let ret = new Array(2)
      if (json.quantities) {
        // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        // Check for ACI... if not, return false
        // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        let q = json.quantities
        if (q) {
          for (let i in q) {
            if (q[i].optionLabel.match(/Adult/gi)) {
              byPax = true
            }
            if (q[i].optionLabel.match(/Child/gi)) {
              byPax = true
            }
            if (q[i].optionLabel.match(/Infant/gi)) {
              byPax = true
            }
          }
        }

        let A = typeof q[0] !== "undefined" ? parseInt(q[0].value) || 0 : 0
        let C = typeof q[1] !== "undefined" ? parseInt(q[1].value) || 0 : 0
        let I = typeof q[2] !== "undefined" ? parseInt(q[2].value) || 0 : 0

        let Adult = parseInt(ret[0]) || 0
        let Child = parseInt(ret[1]) || 0
        let Infant = parseInt(ret[2]) || 0

        ret[0] = Adult + A
        ret[1] = Child + C
        ret[2] = Infant + I

        let ACI = ret

        let code = ""
        ret[0] > 0 ? (code += ret[0] + "A") : code
        ret[1] > 0 ? (code += ret[1] + "C") : code
        ret[2] > 0 ? (code += ret[2] + "I") : code
        let seats = ret[0] + ret[1]

        let pax = {
          adult: ret[0],
          child: ret[1],
          infant: ret[2],
          seats: seats,
          code: code,
          ACI: ACI,
        }
      }
      if (byPax) {
        return pax
      } else {
        return false
      }
    },
    getACI: function (booking) {
      let ret = booking.pax
      return ret.length
    },
    // Stringify Adult/Child/Infant for display (2A3C1I)
    ACI: function (array) {
      let ret = ""
      for (a in array) {
        let A = parseInt(array[a])

        if (A > 0) {
          a = parseInt(a)
          switch (a) {
            case 0:
              ret = ret + array[a] + "A"
              break
            case 1:
              ret = ret + array[a] + "C"
              break
            case 2:
              ret = ret + array[a] + "I"
              break
          }
        }
      }
      return ret
    },
    // Takes either a PlaneCell and a booking or a TableCell and a booking
    // Returns Two cell coordinates, the IN cell and the OUT cell
    getTarget: function (cell, booking) {
      let offset = gya.getOffset(booking.product)
      let row = null
      let col = null

      if (cell.attr("class").search("PlaneCell") >= 0) {
        row = parseInt(time.getRow(booking.time))
        col = parseInt(cell.prop("id").match(/\d+/g)) // Get PlaneCell id digits (which equal the column)
      } else {
        //console.log("Parent Row: %o",cell.parent().prop('id'))
        row = parseInt(cell.parent().prop("id").match(/\d+/g)) // Get Cell Parent id digits (which equal the column)
        col = parseInt(cell.prop("id").slice(-1))
      }
      let IN = [row, col]
      let outRow = row + offset
      let OUT = [outRow, col]
      let isout = false
      if (booking.product && booking.product.toUpperCase().includes("CCF")) {
        isout = true
      }
      if (booking.product && booking.product.toUpperCase().includes("OUTS")) {
        isout = true
      }
      if (cell.data("type") && cell.data("type").toUpperCase().includes("OUTS")) {
        isout = true
      }

      if (isout) {
        OUT = [row, col]
        IN = []
      }
      return [IN, OUT, offset]
    },
    pushKey: function (obj, key, val) {
      let newVal = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(val))
      if (key) {
        if (typeof obj[key] != "undefined") {
          obj[key].push(newVal)
        } else {
          obj[key] = [newVal]
        }
      }
    },
    getTimes: function (bookings, target) {
      let col = target.prop("id").match(/\d+/g) //get only digits
      let match = false
      let returnTripTarget = ""
      //
      // Each Booking
      //
      for (b in bookings) {
        let booking = bookings[b]
        let t = time.getHour(booking.time)
        //
        // Array of all TimeCells
        //
        let all = $(".TimeCell")
          .map(function () {
            return this.id
          })
          .get()
        //
        // Each Timecell
        //
        for (id in all) {
          let row = $("#" + all[id])
            .parent()
            .prop("id")
            .match(/\d+/g) // Get Time Row#

          let cellTime = $("#" + all[id]).text()
          let timeCellID = $("#" + all[id]).prop("id")

          let timeCell = $("#" + row + col)
          let offset = gya.getOffset(booking.product)
          let outRow = parseInt(row) + parseInt(offset) // pull from data
          returnTripTarget = $("#" + outRow + col)

          if (cellTime == t) {
            target = timeCell
            match = true
            break
          }
        }
      }
      if (!match) {
        // Invalid Drop (reject or it will plot on the Plane Cell)
        return null
      }
      return [target, returnTripTarget]
    },
    close: function () {
      //google.script.run()
      google.script.host.close()
    },

      object = object || ""
      message = "<BR>" + message

        }
      }
      return ret
    },

  var arrays = {
    average: function (ary) {
      let sum = 0
      for (let i = 0; i < ary.length; i++) {
        sum += parseInt(ary[i], 10) //don't forget to add the base
      }
      let avg = sum / ary.length
      return avg
    },
    sum: function (ary, maxCol) {
      let col = ary.length
      if (typeof maxCol !== "undefined") {
        col = maxCol
      }
      let sum = 0
      for (let i = 0; i < col; i++) {
        sum += parseInt(ary[i], 10) //don't forget to add the base
      }
      return sum
    },
    colSum: function (a, b) {
      let matrix = [a, b]
      let colSum = matrix.reduce((a, b) => a.map((x, i) => x + b[i]))
      return colSum
    },
    sumArray: function (arry) {
      return arry.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)
    },
    sortFunction: function (a, b) {
      if (a[0] === b[0]) {
        return 0
      } else {
        return a[0] < b[0] ? -1 : 1
      }
    },
    reverseSortFunction: function (a, b) {
      if (a[0] === b[0]) {
        return 0
      } else {
        return a[0] > b[0] ? -1 : 1
      }
    },
    merge(a,b){
      return a.concat(b.filter((item) => a.indexOf(item) < 0))
    }
  }
  root.arrays = arrays
</script>
<script>
  var wb = {
    //
    // Get Balance
    //
    // Accepts a Cell object and returns a WB object
    //
    getBalance: function (dis) {
      return // ******************************** Disabling for now (for testing) ***************************
      let pax = {
        declared: [],
        standard: [],
      }
      //
      // Get Bookings
      //
      let bookings = dis.data("json") // bookings
      //
      // Get Plane
      //
      let row = theBoard.getRow(dis)
      let col = theBoard.getCol(dis)
      let planeCell = $("#ac" + col)
      //
      let PCF = planeCell.data("PCF") // Plane Crew Fuel
      if (!PCF) {
        // ["GA8", Array(2), 150]
        // [ ["Standard", "Pilot", "", "", 83] , null ]
        PCF = ["GA8", [["Standard", "Pilot", "", "", 83], null], 150]
      }
      //
      let plane = PlaneManager.planes.getPlane(PCF[0]) // Get the plane object
      //
      let all_weights = true
      //
      // Build declared array
      //
      // Each Booking in the cell
      //
      let cell = bookings
      for (let b in cell) {
        let booking = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(cell[b])) // operate on a copy
        if (booking && booking.orderNumber) {
          let paxArry = cell[b].pax
          for (let p in paxArry) {
            // push standard weights
            pax.standard.push([paxArry[p].standardWeight, paxArry[p]])
            // push declared weights
            if (paxArry[p].weight.length > 0) {
              pax.declared.push([paxArry[p].weight, paxArry[p]])
            } else {
              all_weights = false
            }
          }
        }
      }
      //
      // Convert LBS to KG (and strip KG/LBS) and add declared_bonus
      //
      for (let a in pax.declared) {
        pax.declared[a][0] = wb.getKilos(pax.declared[a][0]) + gya.standard.declared_bonus
      }
      //
      // Standard or Declared?
      //
      if (all_weights) {
        _pax_list = pax.declared
      } else {
        _pax_list = pax.standard
      }

      // (Reverse)Sort the array (maybe allow it to calculate without sorting later)
      _pax_list.sort(arrays.reverseSortFunction)
      //

      //
      // Put pilot and copilot in seats (standard or declared)
      //
      let _pilotW = PCF[1][0][4] + gya.standard.declared_bonus
      if (!all_weights) {
        _pilotW = gya.standard.adult
      }
      let POB = [[_pilotW, PCF[1][0][0]]]

      let _cPilotW
      if (!!PCF[1][1]) {
        _cPilotW = PCF[1][1][4] + gya.standard.declared_bonus
        if (!all_weights) {
          _cPilotW = gya.standard.adult
        }
        POB.push([_cPilotW, PCF[1][1][0]])
      }
      //
      // Put Pax in seats
      //
      let tPaxW = 0
      for (let a in _pax_list) {
        POB.push(_pax_list[a]) // [0,1] 0=weight 1=paxObject
        tPaxW += parseInt(_pax_list[a][0])
      }
      //
      // load everything into the plane
      //
      plane.load(PCF, POB)
      let WB = plane.getOldWB() // calculate the results (returns an object)
      //WB.plane = plane

      WB.tPaxW = tPaxW
      WB.numPax = _pax_list.length
      WB.all_weights = all_weights
      WB.lastSeatRange = this.getLastSeatRange(PCF, POB)
      return WB
    },
    // Given a plane and load, return min/max weight range for the last seat
    getLastSeatRange: function (PCF, POB) {
      let ret
      let plane = PlaneManager.planes.getPlane(PCF[0])
      let numPOB = POB.length
      let numSeats = plane.arms.seats.length

      if (numPOB == numSeats - 1) {
        let lastSeat = POB.length
        let range = []
        for (let i = 0; i <= 130; i++) {
          POB[lastSeat] = [i, ""]
          plane.load(PCF, POB)
          let WB = plane.getOldWB()
          let _cg = WB.getCG()
          let _AUW = WB.getWeight()
          if (_cg > 0 && _AUW > 0) {
            range[0] = i
            range[1] = _cg
            range[2] = _AUW
          } else {
            break
          }
        }
        POB.pop() // remove last seat
        return range
      }

      return ""
    },
    getKilos: function (string) {
      let factor = 1
      if (!string) {
        return
      }
      if (
        string.toUpperCase().indexOf("LBS") > 0 ||
        string.toUpperCase().indexOf("LB") > 0 ||
        string.toUpperCase().indexOf("POUND") > 0
      ) {
        factor = 2.20462
      }
      let ret = parseInt(string) / factor
      ret = Math.round(ret)
      return ret
    },
  }
</script>

// The old booking manifest div:
    //
    // Booking Div (Booking Sprite)
    //
    // ***************** "style" can probably be removed ****************************
    getBookingDiv(booking, style) {
      let vis = style == "compact" ? false : true
      vis = false
      let container = ""
      let ret = "<span class='tooltip'>"
      if (booking.orderNumber) {
        let masterkey = booking.orderNumber.split("-")[0]
        ret =
          ret +
          // "2FCF" coded sprite
          '<span style="float:left"><div class="BookingSprite Manifest" id="' +
          booking.orderNumber +
          '"' +
          "> " +
          '<span style="font-weight:bold;background-color:' +
          colors.getByTime(booking.time) +
          '">' +
          booking.seats +
          " " +
          booking.product +
          "</span>" +
          "</div></span>"
        // verbose section
        ret += '<span class="tooltiptext">'
        ret +=
          "<A href='https://app.rezdy.com/orders/edit/" +
          masterkey +
          "' target='_blank' style='color: lightgrey;'>" +
          booking.orderNumber +
          "</a><br>"

        for (let p in booking.pax) {
          let firstName = booking.pax[p].firstName || ""
          let lastName = booking.pax[p].lastName || ""
          let weight = booking.pax[p].weight || ""
          //
          // Display LBS as KG
          //
          let inKG = weight
          if (!!inKG && inKG.match(/lb/gi)) {
            let w = inKG.toLowerCase().split("lb")[0]
            inKG = Math.round(parseInt(w) / 2.2)
            inKG = " [ " + inKG + " kg] "
          }
          if (!!inKG && inKG.match(/pound/gi)) {
            let w = inKG.toLowerCase().split("pound")[0]
            inKG = Math.round(parseInt(w) / 2.2)
            inKG = " [ " + inKG + " kg] "
          }

          if (vis) {
            ret +=
              '<div class="BookingSprite Manifest Individual" id="' +
              booking.orderNumber +
              '"> ' +
              "<span style='font-size: x-small' >" +
              time.getHour(booking.time) +
              "</span> " +
              "(" +
              utility.ACI(booking.ACI) +
              ") " +
              "(" +
              inKG +
              ")" +
              "</div><br>"
          } else {
            ret += firstName + lastName + " ( " + inKG + " ) " + "<br>"
          }
        }
        if (booking.pickupLocation) {
          if (booking.pickupLocation.locationName) {
            ret += "<br><span>" + booking.pickupLocation.locationName + "</span>"
          }
        }
        ret = ret + "<P><span>" + booking.internalNotes + "</span>"
        ret = ret + "</span>"
      }
      container = container + ret + "</span>"
      return container
    }














































      //
      // An array to store the bookings
      //
      let bookings = {}
      //
      // Translate Rezdy objects into our booking object structure
      //
      for (let a in data.bookings) {
        console.log("Booking: %o", data.bookings[a])
        //
        // if there's no orderNumber, skip it
        //
        if (!data.bookings[a].orderNumber) {
          break
        }
        let container = data.bookings[a]

        //
        // Rezdy groups multiple bookings into "items"
        // We'll loop over them and seperate them out.
        //
        let rezdyBookings = data.bookings[a].items
        for (let i in rezdyBookings) {
          console.log("Booking# %o", i)

          let rezdyBooking = rezdyBookings[i]
          let booking = {}
          booking.flight = {} // an object for our data
          //
          // Copy in the container's data to each booking
          //
          booking.orderNumber = container.orderNumber
          booking.status = container.status

          //
          // multiPass is for multiple bookings per order
          //
          let multiPass = ""
          if (i > 0) {
            multiPass = "-" + i
          }
          booking.orderNumber = data.bookings[a].orderNumber + multiPass
          booking.bookingName = data.bookings[a].customer.firstName + " " + data.bookings[a].customer.lastName

          console.log("Trip Codes")
          //
          // This could be cleaned up (probably just call the function when necessary?) -- Load tripcodes from spreadsheet ************************
          //
          booking.productCode = gya.getCode(rezdyBooking.productCode) // row from TripCodes spreadsheet

          // This seems right... we want to have the product code handy ****************************
          booking.product = booking.productCode[2] || "" // Blank in case missing code in spreadsheet

          // ***********************************************************
          // now the real work begins...
          //
          // Again, these might do well as function returns rather than writing them here? (depends how deep getPax is?) *********************
          // These should be internal functions, not callouts to utility
          // ***********************************************************
          booking.seats = utility.getPax(rezdyBooking).seats

          if (!booking.seats) {
            booking.seats = 0
          }

          booking.flight.ACI = utility.getPax(rezdyBooking).ACI
          booking.flight.seats = booking.seats

          booking.flight.date = Dates.getNZ(rezdyBooking.startTimeLocal)
          booking.flight.ETD = time.getTime(rezdyBooking.endTimeLocal)
          booking.pickupLocation = rezdyBooking.pickupLocation

          // **********************************************************************************************
          // This is something that could use some work... cuz it's a Rezdy hatchet job.
          // **********************************************************************************************
          //
          // Extras aren't linked to passengers ... like picnick lunches... the number of them is all that the booking knows
          //
          // Extras
          //
          // Flatten the list of extras
          let ext = []
          // each extra
          if (!!rezdyBookings.extras) {
            for (let e in rezdyBooking.extras) {
              // For Each Quantity, push an extra into the ext array
              for (let num = 0; num <= rezdyBooking.extras[e].quantity; num++) {
                ext.push(rezdyBooking.extras.extras[e])
              }
            }
          }
          console.log("Our Booking: %o", booking)
        }

        continue // Just skipping all this old code *************************************************

        // Check status before continuing
        if (data.bookings[a].status == "CONFIRMED" && data.bookings[a].orderNumber) {
          //
          // -- Skip wrapper data and use "Items" as bookings" --
          //
          let rezdyBookings = data.bookings[a].items
          for (let i in rezdyBookings) {
            let rezdyBooking = rezdyBookings[i]
            let booking = {}
            booking.flight = {} // an object for our data
            //
            // Pull some parent values down into the booking so we don't lose them
            //
            //
            // multiPass is for multiple bookings per order
            //
            let multiPass = ""
            if (i > 0) {
              multiPass = "-" + i
            }
            booking.orderNumber = data.bookings[a].orderNumber + multiPass
            booking.resellerAlias = data.bookings[a].resellerAlias
            booking.bookingName = data.bookings[a].customer.firstName + " " + data.bookings[a].customer.lastName
            //
            // Translate Rezdy Booking to our idea of a booking
            //
            booking.productCode = gya.getCode(rezdyBooking.productCode) // row from TripCodes spreadsheet
            booking.product = booking.productCode[2] || "" // Blank in case missing code in spreadsheet

            // ***********************************************************
            // These should be internal functions, not callouts to utility
            // ***********************************************************
            booking.seats = utility.getPax(rezdyBooking).seats

            if (!booking.seats) {
              booking.seats = 0
            }

            booking.flight.ACI = utility.getPax(rezdyBooking).ACI
            booking.flight.seats = booking.seats

            booking.extras = rezdyBooking.extras
            booking.time = rezdyBooking.startTimeLocal
            booking.endTime = rezdyBooking.endTimeLocal

            booking.flight.date = Dates.getNZ(booking.time)
            booking.flight.ETD = time.getTime(booking.time)

            booking.sourceChannel = rezdyBooking.sourceChannel
            booking.pickupLocation = rezdyBooking.pickupLocation
            booking.internalNotes = data.bookings[a].internalNotes

            // Flatten the list of extras
            let ext = []
            // each extra
            for (let e in booking.extras) {
              // For Each Quantity, push an extra into the ext array
              for (let num = 0; num <= booking.extras[e].quantity; num++) {
                ext.push(booking.extras[e])
              }
            }
            //
            // Parse Pax Data
            //
            let pax = []
            //
            // If ACI returned false, ignore it.
            //
            let sumACI = 0
            if (booking.ACI) {
              sumACI = arrays.sum(booking.ACI, 2)
            }
            //
            // Check Passenger list against ACI *************************************************************
            //
            if (rezdyBooking.participants.length >= sumACI) {
              //
              // Pax List is Good... so use the entered passenger names and details
              //
              for (let p in rezdyBooking.participants) {
                let px = rezdyBooking.participants[p]
                let person = {}
                //
                // Key each individual with the booking order + their number in the pax array
                //
                person.key = booking.orderNumber + "_" + p
                person.paxNumber = p
                person.product = booking.product
                person.productCode = booking.productCode
                person.pickupLocation = booking.pickupLocation
                person.extra = "" // blank so we can just add it to strings without checking
                //
                // Assign Extras to passengers
                // This will invariably give the wrong type of extra to some people (like vegitarian stuff), but it'll be close enough for now *************
                //
                if (ext[p]) {
                  person.extra = ext[p]
                }
                //
                //
                //
                for (let f in px.fields) {
                  if (typeof px.fields[f] !== "undefined") {
                    //
                    // Everyone's an adult unless specified otherwise
                    //
                    person.standardWeight = gya.standard.adult

                    switch (px.fields[f].label) {
                      case "First Name":
                        person.firstName = px.fields[f].value || booking.bookingName + p

                      case "Last Name":
                        person.lastName = px.fields[f].value || ""

                      case "Passenger weight (Please specify units: kg or lbs)":
                        person.weight = px.fields[f].value || ""
                    }
                  }
                }
                if (booking.ACI && p < booking.ACI[0]) {
                } else {
                  person.standardWeight = gya.standard.child
                }
                pax.push(person)
              }
            } else {
              //
              // Generate names from ACI
              //
              for (let p = 0; p < sumACI; p++) {
                // number of ACI
                let person = {}
                //
                // Key each individual with the booking order + their number in the pax array
                //
                person.key = booking.orderNumber + "_" + p
                person.paxNumber = p
                person.firstName = booking.orderNumber + "_" + p
                person.lastName = "[Generated]"
                person.weight = 0
                person.standardWeight = gya.standard.adult
                pax.push(person)
              }
            }

            booking.pax = pax

            // ************************************************************************************************************************

            // Key/Record/Note if something is an "out" of sorts (overnight cruises, etc) and maybe note the out time?

            // ******************************************************************************************************************************************************
            // This might be able to be replaced by looking at the "EndTime" from the booking... but likely still needs to account for the flight duration **********
            booking.offset = gya.getOffset(booking.product) // Get the time (in hours) before the return departure

            // To Array or not to Array, that is the question *****************************************************
            bookings[booking.orderNumber] = booking

            // ************************************************************************************************************************
          }
        }
      }
      return bookings
</script>
